package com.beeeye;

import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.TextureTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.CommandEncoder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

/**
 * Stereo 3D rendering with side-by-side output.
 *
 * Approach:
 * 1. Fake screen width to half (UI thinks screen is half width)
 * 2. Render world twice (left eye, right eye) with camera offset
 * 3. Render UI once to transparent FBO at half width
 * 4. Composite: left eye | right eye, then overlay UI on both
 */
public class StereoRenderer {

    public enum Eye {
        LEFT(-1),
        RIGHT(1);

        public final int sign;

        Eye(int sign) {
            this.sign = sign;
        }
    }

    // Current rendering state
    private static Eye currentEye = null;
    private static boolean inStereoPass = false;
    private static boolean renderingWorld = false;
    private static boolean bypassMainTargetOverride = false;

    // FBOs
    private static RenderTarget leftEyeFbo = null;
    private static RenderTarget rightEyeFbo = null;
    private static RenderTarget uiFbo = null; // Half-width, transparent, for UI only

    // Cached dimensions
    private static int lastWidth = 0;
    private static int lastHeight = 0;

    // Faked width for UI rendering
    private static int fakedWidth = 0;

    public static Eye getCurrentEye() {
        return currentEye;
    }

    public static boolean isInStereoPass() {
        return inStereoPass;
    }

    public static boolean isRenderingWorld() {
        return renderingWorld;
    }

    public static void setCurrentEye(Eye eye) {
        currentEye = eye;
    }

    public static void setInStereoPass(boolean inPass) {
        inStereoPass = inPass;
    }

    public static void setRenderingWorld(boolean rendering) {
        renderingWorld = rendering;
    }

    public static boolean shouldBypassMainTargetOverride() {
        return bypassMainTargetOverride;
    }

    public static void setBypassMainTargetOverride(boolean bypass) {
        bypassMainTargetOverride = bypass;
    }

    /**
     * Get the faked width for UI rendering (half of real width).
     */
    public static int getFakedWidth() {
        return fakedWidth;
    }

    /**
     * Check if width should be faked (during stereo mode).
     */
    public static boolean shouldFakeWidth() {
        return Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() && fakedWidth > 0;
    }

    /**
     * Get camera X offset for current eye in blocks.
     */
    public static float getEyeOffset() {
        if (currentEye == null) return 0;
        float eyeDistance = BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue();
        return currentEye.sign * (eyeDistance / 2.0f);
    }

    public static int getScreenShift() {
        return BeeeyeConfig.SCREEN_SHIFT.get();
    }

    public static int getInterfaceShift() {
        return BeeeyeConfig.INTERFACE_SHIFT.get();
    }

    /**
     * Get crosshair offset for convergence at target distance.
     */
    public static int getCrosshairOffset() {
        if (currentEye == null) return 0;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return 0;

        double targetDistance = getTargetDistance();
        if (targetDistance <= 0) return 0;

        float eyeDistance = BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue();
        int guiWidth = mc.getWindow().getGuiScaledWidth();
        float screenFactor = guiWidth * 0.5f;
        float parallax = (float) (eyeDistance / targetDistance) * screenFactor;
        parallax = Math.min(parallax, guiWidth * 0.1f);

        return (int) (currentEye.sign * parallax);
    }

    public static double getTargetDistance() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return 100.0;

        HitResult hitResult = mc.hitResult;
        if (hitResult == null || hitResult.getType() == HitResult.Type.MISS) {
            return 100.0;
        }

        Vec3 hitLocation = hitResult.getLocation();
        Vec3 eyePosition = mc.player.getEyePosition();
        double distance = eyePosition.distanceTo(hitLocation);

        return Math.max(distance, 0.5);
    }

    /**
     * Initialize FBOs for stereo rendering.
     */
    public static void ensureFramebuffers(int fullWidth, int fullHeight) {
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;

        if (
            leftEyeFbo != null &&
            lastWidth == fullWidth &&
            lastHeight == fullHeight
        ) {
            return;
        }

        Beeeye.LOGGER.info(
            "Creating stereo framebuffers: {}x{} (half: {})",
            fullWidth,
            fullHeight,
            halfWidth
        );

        cleanup();

        // Eye FBOs at half width (each eye renders to half screen)
        leftEyeFbo = new TextureTarget(
            "Beeeye Left Eye",
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            true
        );
        rightEyeFbo = new TextureTarget(
            "Beeeye Right Eye",
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            true
        );

        // UI FBO at half width with transparency
        uiFbo = new TextureTarget("Beeeye UI", halfWidth, fullHeight, false);

        lastWidth = fullWidth;
        lastHeight = fullHeight;
        fakedWidth = halfWidth;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getLeftEyeFbo() {
        return leftEyeFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getRightEyeFbo() {
        return rightEyeFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getUiFbo() {
        return uiFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getEyeFbo(Eye eye) {
        return eye == Eye.LEFT ? leftEyeFbo : rightEyeFbo;
    }

    /**
     * Clear an FBO with transparent black.
     */
    public static void clearFbo(RenderTarget fbo) {
        if (fbo == null) return;
        GpuTexture colorTex = fbo.getColorTexture();
        GpuTexture depthTex = fbo.getDepthTexture();
        if (colorTex == null) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder =
            RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        if (depthTex != null) {
            encoder.clearColorAndDepthTextures(colorTex, 0, depthTex, 1.0);
        } else {
            encoder.clearColorTexture(colorTex, 0);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Copy texture to screen at specified position.
     * copyTextureToTexture signature: (src, dst, mipLevel, dstX, dstY, srcX, srcY, width, height)
     */
    public static void copyToScreen(
        RenderTarget src,
        RenderTarget screen,
        int dstX,
        int dstY,
        int width,
        int height
    ) {
        if (src == null || screen == null) return;

        GpuTexture srcTex = src.getColorTexture();
        GpuTexture dstTex = screen.getColorTexture();
        if (srcTex == null || dstTex == null) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder =
            RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        // Signature: (src, dst, mipLevel, dstX, dstY, srcX, srcY, width, height)
        encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
            srcTex,
            dstTex,
            0, // mipLevel
            dstX,
            dstY, // dstX, dstY
            0,
            0, // srcX, srcY
            width,
            height
        );
    }

    /**
     * Blend UI FBO onto screen (both halves).
     * Uses blitAndBlendToTexture for alpha blending.
     */
    public static void blendUiToScreen(RenderTarget screen) {
        if (uiFbo == null || screen == null) return;

        int halfWidth = fakedWidth;
        int height = screen.height;
        int shift = getScreenShift();

        // Blend UI to left half
        // For now, just copy - blending needs shader support
        copyToScreen(uiFbo, screen, 0, 0, halfWidth, height);

        // Blend UI to right half
        copyToScreen(
            uiFbo,
            screen,
            halfWidth + shift,
            0,
            halfWidth - shift,
            height
        );
    }

    /**
     * Composite the stereo image to screen.
     * Left eye -> left half, Right eye -> right half.
     */
    public static void compositeToScreen(RenderTarget screen) {
        if (leftEyeFbo == null || rightEyeFbo == null) return;

        int halfWidth = fakedWidth;
        int height = screen.height;
        int shift = getScreenShift();

        // Eye FBOs are halfWidth wide, copy full content to screen halves
        // Left eye FBO -> left half of screen (0 to halfWidth+shift)
        int leftCopyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth, halfWidth + shift);
        copyToScreen(leftEyeFbo, screen, 0, 0, leftCopyWidth, height);

        // Right eye FBO -> right half of screen (halfWidth+shift to end)
        int rightDstX = halfWidth + shift;
        int rightCopyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth, screen.width - rightDstX);
        if (rightCopyWidth > 0) {
            copyToScreen(
                rightEyeFbo,
                screen,
                rightDstX,
                0,
                rightCopyWidth,
                height
            );
        }
    }

    public static void cleanup() {
        if (leftEyeFbo != null) {
            leftEyeFbo.destroyBuffers();
            leftEyeFbo = null;
        }
        if (rightEyeFbo != null) {
            rightEyeFbo.destroyBuffers();
            rightEyeFbo = null;
        }
        if (uiFbo != null) {
            uiFbo.destroyBuffers();
            uiFbo = null;
        }
        lastWidth = 0;
        lastHeight = 0;
        fakedWidth = 0;
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.CommandEncoder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.render.state.GuiRenderState;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * Stereo rendering approach:
 * 1. Fake screen width to half for all UI/interface rendering
 * 2. Render left eye world to left FBO
 * 3. Render right eye world to right FBO
 * 4. Composite: left|right eyes, then UI overlay on both halves
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private GuiRenderState guiRenderState;

    @Shadow
    public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$inStereoRender = false;

    /**
     * Intercept the entire render to implement stereo.
     */
    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderHead(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        boolean renderLevel,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) {
            return;
        }

        // Don't intercept if not in game
        if (minecraft.level == null || !renderLevel) {
            return;
        }

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;

        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;

        // Ensure FBOs exist (for faked width calculations)
        StereoRenderer.ensureFramebuffers(fullWidth, fullHeight);

        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(true);

        // Render world normally to full screen
        // Camera offset is applied by MixinCamera for LEFT eye
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.LEFT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(true);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);

        // Copy left half of rendered world to right half
        // This gives both eyes the same world view (simple side-by-side)
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();
        GpuTexture texture = mainTarget.getColorTexture();
        if (texture != null) {
            CommandEncoder encoder =
                RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
            // Copy left half to right half
            encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                texture,
                texture,
                0,
                halfWidth + shift,
                0, // dstX, dstY
                0,
                0, // srcX, srcY
                halfWidth - shift,
                fullHeight
            );
        }

        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);

        // Render GUI/HUD at faked half-width, then copy to right
        beeeye$renderGuiStereo(deltaTracker, mainTarget);
    }

    /**
     * Render GUI at half-width, then copy to both halves.
     */
    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderGuiStereo(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        RenderTarget mainTarget
    ) {
        // Get mouse coordinates
        int mouseX = (int) minecraft.mouseHandler.getScaledXPos(
            minecraft.getWindow()
        );
        int mouseY = (int) minecraft.mouseHandler.getScaledYPos(
            minecraft.getWindow()
        );

        // Reset GUI render state and create GuiGraphics
        guiRenderState.reset();
        GuiGraphics guiGraphics = new GuiGraphics(
            minecraft,
            guiRenderState,
            mouseX,
            mouseY
        );

        // GUI renders at faked half-width via MixinWindow
        // It draws to the left half of the screen
        minecraft.gui.render(guiGraphics, deltaTracker);

        // Copy left half to right half for HUD
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int height = mainTarget.height;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        GpuTexture texture = mainTarget.getColorTexture();
        if (texture == null) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder =
            RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        // Copy left half to right half
        // copyTextureToTexture: (src, dst, mipLevel, dstX, dstY, srcX, srcY, width, height)
        encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
            texture,
            texture,
            0, // mipLevel
            halfWidth + shift,
            0, // dstX, dstY (right half)
            0,
            0, // srcX, srcY (left half)
            halfWidth - shift,
            height
        );
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.platform.Window;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * Fake window width to half during stereo mode.
 * This makes all UI/interfaces render at half width.
 */
@Mixin(Window.class)
public class MixinWindow {

    @Shadow
    private int framebufferWidth;

    @Shadow
    private int guiScaledWidth;

    /**
     * Fake framebuffer width to half.
     */
    @Inject(method = "getWidth", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$fakeWidth(CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if (StereoRenderer.shouldFakeWidth() && !StereoRenderer.isRenderingWorld()) {
            cir.setReturnValue(StereoRenderer.getFakedWidth());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Fake screen width (same as framebuffer on most systems).
     */
    @Inject(method = "getScreenWidth", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$fakeScreenWidth(CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if (StereoRenderer.shouldFakeWidth() && !StereoRenderer.isRenderingWorld()) {
            cir.setReturnValue(StereoRenderer.getFakedWidth());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Fake GUI scaled width.
     */
    @Inject(method = "getGuiScaledWidth", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$fakeGuiScaledWidth(CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if (StereoRenderer.shouldFakeWidth() && !StereoRenderer.isRenderingWorld()) {
            // Calculate scaled width based on faked framebuffer width
            int fakedWidth = StereoRenderer.getFakedWidth();
            double guiScale = ((Window)(Object)this).getGuiScale();
            int scaledWidth = (int) Math.ceil(fakedWidth / guiScale);
            cir.setReturnValue(scaledWidth);
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.Camera;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

@Mixin(Camera.class)
public abstract class MixinCamera {

    @Shadow
    protected abstract void move(
        float distanceOffset,
        float verticalOffset,
        float horizontalOffset
    );

    /**
     * After camera setup, apply stereo eye offset.
     * The offset is applied along the camera's local X axis (right vector).
     */
    @Inject(method = "setup", at = @At("TAIL"))
    private void applyEyeOffset(
        Level level,
        Entity entity,
        boolean detached,
        boolean thirdPersonReverse,
        float partialTick,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || !StereoRenderer.isInStereoPass()) {
            return;
        }

        float offset = StereoRenderer.getEyeOffset();
        if (offset != 0) {
            // move(forward, up, right) - we want to move along right axis
            move(0, 0, offset);
        }
    }
}

        at = @At("HEAD"),
        cancellable = true
    )

            if (fbo != null) {
                cir.setReturnValue(fbo);
            }
        }
    }

 *
 * With faked width, screens render at half width automatically.
 * After render, we copy from left half to right half.
 */
public class ScreenRenderHandler {

     * Get mouse X offset - no longer needed with faked width approach.
     * Mouse coordinates are already in half-width space.
     */
    public static double getMouseXOffset() {
        return 0;
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public void onScreenRenderPost(ScreenEvent.Render.Post event) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled()) {
            return;
        }

        Screen screen = event.getScreen();
        if (screen == null) {
            return;
        }

        // Copy left half to right half
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        RenderTarget mainTarget = mc.getMainRenderTarget();

        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int height = mainTarget.height;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        GpuTexture texture = mainTarget.getColorTexture();

            RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        // Copy left half to right half
        // copyTextureToTexture: (src, dst, mipLevel, dstX, dstY, srcX, srcY, width, height)
        encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
            texture,
            texture,
            0, // mipLevel
            halfWidth + shift,
            0, // dstX, dstY (right half)
            0,
            0, // srcX, srcY (left half)
            halfWidth - shift,
            height
        );
    }

package com.beeeye;

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.common.NeoForge;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

@Mod(Beeeye.MOD_ID)
public class Beeeye {

    public static final String MOD_ID = "beeeye";
    public static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MOD_ID);

    private static boolean stereoEnabled = false;

    public Beeeye(IEventBus modEventBus, ModContainer modContainer) {
        LOGGER.info("Beeeye initializing...");

        modContainer.registerConfig(ModConfig.Type.CLIENT, BeeeyeConfig.SPEC);

        modEventBus.addListener(this::onClientSetup);
        modEventBus.addListener(this::onRegisterKeyMappings);

        NeoForge.EVENT_BUS.addListener(this::onClientTick);
        NeoForge.EVENT_BUS.register(new ScreenRenderHandler());
    }

    private void onClientSetup(FMLClientSetupEvent event) {
        LOGGER.info("Beeeye client setup complete");
    }

    private void onRegisterKeyMappings(RegisterKeyMappingsEvent event) {
        event.register(BeeeyeKeyBindings.TOGGLE_STEREO);
        LOGGER.info("Beeeye keybindings registered");
    }

    private void onClientTick(ClientTickEvent.Post event) {
        while (BeeeyeKeyBindings.TOGGLE_STEREO.consumeClick()) {
            stereoEnabled = !stereoEnabled;
            LOGGER.info(
                "Stereo rendering: {}",
                stereoEnabled ? "ENABLED" : "DISABLED"
            );

            // Show on-screen message
            Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
            if (mc.player != null) {
                String status = stereoEnabled ? "ON" : "OFF";
                mc.player.displayClientMessage(
                    Component.literal("Beeeye Stereo: " + status),
                    true
                );
            }

            // Clean up FBOs when disabled
            if (!stereoEnabled) {
                StereoRenderer.cleanup();
            }
        }
    }

    public static boolean isStereoEnabled() {
        return stereoEnabled;
    }

    public static void setStereoEnabled(boolean enabled) {
        stereoEnabled = enabled;
        if (!enabled) {
            StereoRenderer.cleanup();
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye;

import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.TextureTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.CommandEncoder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

/**
 * Stereo 3D rendering with side-by-side output.
 *
 * 5-Phase Approach:
 * 1. Fake screen width to half for other mods (MixinWindow)
 * 2. During world render, use transparent HUD buffer - don't draw HUD yet
 * 3. Let Minecraft and mods draw their HUD to the transparent buffer
 * 4. Draw left eye world to left half, right eye world to right half
 * 5. Blend HUD buffer onto both eye halves
 */
public class StereoRenderer {

    public enum Eye {
        LEFT(-1),
        RIGHT(1);

        public final int sign;

        Eye(int sign) {
            this.sign = sign;
        }
    }

    // Current rendering state
    private static Eye currentEye = null;
    private static boolean inStereoPass = false;
    private static boolean renderingWorld = false;
    private static boolean renderingHud = false;
    private static boolean bypassMainTargetOverride = false;

    // FBOs for eye rendering (full screen, we render to halves)
    private static RenderTarget leftEyeFbo = null;
    private static RenderTarget rightEyeFbo = null;
    
    // HUD FBO - half width, transparent background, captures all UI
    private static RenderTarget hudFbo = null;

    // Cached dimensions
    private static int lastWidth = 0;
    private static int lastHeight = 0;

    // Faked width for UI rendering (half of real)
    private static int fakedWidth = 0;

    public static Eye getCurrentEye() {
        return currentEye;
    }

    public static boolean isInStereoPass() {
        return inStereoPass;
    }

    public static boolean isRenderingWorld() {
        return renderingWorld;
    }

    public static boolean isRenderingHud() {
        return renderingHud;
    }

    public static void setCurrentEye(Eye eye) {
        currentEye = eye;
    }

    public static void setInStereoPass(boolean inPass) {
        inStereoPass = inPass;
    }

    public static void setRenderingWorld(boolean rendering) {
        renderingWorld = rendering;
    }

    public static void setRenderingHud(boolean rendering) {
        renderingHud = rendering;
    }

    public static boolean shouldBypassMainTargetOverride() {
        return bypassMainTargetOverride;
    }

    public static void setBypassMainTargetOverride(boolean bypass) {
        bypassMainTargetOverride = bypass;
    }

    /**
     * Get the faked width for UI rendering (half of real width).
     */
    public static int getFakedWidth() {
        return fakedWidth;
    }

    /**
     * Get the full screen width.
     */
    public static int getFullWidth() {
        return lastWidth;
    }

    /**
     * Get the full screen height.
     */
    public static int getFullHeight() {
        return lastHeight;
    }

    /**
     * Check if width should be faked (during stereo mode, not rendering world).
     */
    public static boolean shouldFakeWidth() {
        return Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() && fakedWidth > 0 && !renderingWorld;
    }

    /**
     * Get camera X offset for current eye in blocks.
     */
    public static float getEyeOffset() {
        if (currentEye == null) return 0;
        float eyeDistance = BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue();
        return currentEye.sign * (eyeDistance / 2.0f);
    }

    public static int getScreenShift() {
        return BeeeyeConfig.SCREEN_SHIFT.get();
    }

    public static int getInterfaceShift() {
        return BeeeyeConfig.INTERFACE_SHIFT.get();
    }

    /**
     * Get crosshair offset for convergence at target distance.
     */
    public static int getCrosshairOffset() {
        if (currentEye == null) return 0;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return 0;

        double targetDistance = getTargetDistance();
        if (targetDistance <= 0) return 0;

        float eyeDistance = BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue();
        int guiWidth = mc.getWindow().getGuiScaledWidth();
        float screenFactor = guiWidth * 0.5f;
        float parallax = (float) (eyeDistance / targetDistance) * screenFactor;
        parallax = Math.min(parallax, guiWidth * 0.1f);

        return (int) (currentEye.sign * parallax);
    }

    public static double getTargetDistance() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return 100.0;

        HitResult hitResult = mc.hitResult;
        if (hitResult == null || hitResult.getType() == HitResult.Type.MISS) {
            return 100.0;
        }

        Vec3 hitLocation = hitResult.getLocation();
        Vec3 eyePosition = mc.player.getEyePosition();
        double distance = eyePosition.distanceTo(hitLocation);

        return Math.max(distance, 0.5);
    }

    /**
     * Initialize FBOs for stereo rendering.
     * Eye FBOs: half width each (for left/right eye world)
     * HUD FBO: half width (for UI overlay, transparent)
     */
    public static void ensureFramebuffers(int fullWidth, int fullHeight) {
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;

        if (leftEyeFbo != null && lastWidth == fullWidth && lastHeight == fullHeight) {
            return;
        }

        Beeeye.LOGGER.info(
            "Creating stereo framebuffers: {}x{} (half: {})",
            fullWidth,
            fullHeight,
            halfWidth
        );

        cleanup();

        // Eye FBOs at half width - each eye gets its own half-screen FBO
        leftEyeFbo = new TextureTarget("Beeeye Left Eye", halfWidth, fullHeight, true);
        rightEyeFbo = new TextureTarget("Beeeye Right Eye", halfWidth, fullHeight, true);

        // HUD FBO at half width - transparent, for UI capture
        // No depth buffer needed for 2D UI
        hudFbo = new TextureTarget("Beeeye HUD", halfWidth, fullHeight, false);

        lastWidth = fullWidth;
        lastHeight = fullHeight;
        fakedWidth = halfWidth;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getLeftEyeFbo() {
        return leftEyeFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getRightEyeFbo() {
        return rightEyeFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getHudFbo() {
        return hudFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getEyeFbo(Eye eye) {
        return eye == Eye.LEFT ? leftEyeFbo : rightEyeFbo;
    }

    /**
     * Clear an FBO with transparent black.
     */
    public static void clearFbo(RenderTarget fbo) {
        if (fbo == null) return;
        GpuTexture colorTex = fbo.getColorTexture();
        GpuTexture depthTex = fbo.getDepthTexture();
        if (colorTex == null) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        if (depthTex != null) {
            encoder.clearColorAndDepthTextures(colorTex, 0, depthTex, 1.0);
        } else {
            encoder.clearColorTexture(colorTex, 0);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Copy texture region to screen.
     * copyTextureToTexture signature: (src, dst, mipLevel, dstX, dstY, srcX, srcY, width, height)
     */
    public static void copyToScreen(
        RenderTarget src,
        RenderTarget dst,
        int dstX,
        int dstY,
        int srcX,
        int srcY,
        int width,
        int height
    ) {
        if (src == null || dst == null) return;

        GpuTexture srcTex = src.getColorTexture();
        GpuTexture dstTex = dst.getColorTexture();
        if (srcTex == null || dstTex == null) return;

        // Clamp to valid bounds
        width = Math.min(width, Math.min(srcTex.getWidth(0) - srcX, dstTex.getWidth(0) - dstX));
        height = Math.min(height, Math.min(srcTex.getHeight(0) - srcY, dstTex.getHeight(0) - dstY));
        
        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
            srcTex, dstTex,
            0,              // mipLevel
            dstX, dstY,     // destination position
            srcX, srcY,     // source position
            width, height
        );
    }

    /**
     * Composite stereo frame to main screen.
     * Left eye FBO -> left half of screen
     * Right eye FBO -> right half of screen
     */
    public static void compositeEyesToScreen(RenderTarget screen) {
        if (leftEyeFbo == null || rightEyeFbo == null || screen == null) return;

        int halfWidth = fakedWidth;
        int height = screen.height;
        int shift = getScreenShift();

        // Left eye to left half (position 0)
        int leftCopyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth, halfWidth + shift);
        copyToScreen(leftEyeFbo, screen, 0, 0, 0, 0, leftCopyWidth, height);

        // Right eye to right half (position halfWidth + shift)
        int rightDstX = halfWidth + shift;
        int rightCopyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth, screen.width - rightDstX);
        if (rightCopyWidth > 0) {
            copyToScreen(rightEyeFbo, screen, rightDstX, 0, 0, 0, rightCopyWidth, height);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Blend HUD onto both halves of the screen.
     * HUD FBO contains UI rendered at half width.
     */
    public static void blendHudToScreen(RenderTarget screen) {
        if (hudFbo == null || screen == null) return;

        int halfWidth = fakedWidth;
        int height = screen.height;
        int shift = getScreenShift();
        int interfaceShift = getInterfaceShift();

        // Copy HUD to left half
        copyToScreen(hudFbo, screen, 0, 0, 0, 0, halfWidth, height);

        // Copy HUD to right half (with shift)
        int rightDstX = halfWidth + shift;
        int rightCopyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth - shift, screen.width - rightDstX);
        if (rightCopyWidth > 0) {
            copyToScreen(hudFbo, screen, rightDstX, 0, 0, 0, rightCopyWidth, height);
        }
    }

    public static void cleanup() {
        if (leftEyeFbo != null) {
            leftEyeFbo.destroyBuffers();
            leftEyeFbo = null;
        }
        if (rightEyeFbo != null) {
            rightEyeFbo.destroyBuffers();
            rightEyeFbo = null;
        }
        if (hudFbo != null) {
            hudFbo.destroyBuffers();
            hudFbo = null;
        }
        lastWidth = 0;
        lastHeight = 0;
        fakedWidth = 0;
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.render.state.GuiRenderState;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * 5-Phase Stereo Rendering:
 * 
 * Phase 1: Fake screen width to half for all mods (MixinWindow handles this)
 * Phase 2: Skip normal world rendering, prepare transparent HUD buffer
 * Phase 3: Let Minecraft and mods draw HUD to our captured buffer
 * Phase 4: Render left eye world, then right eye world
 * Phase 5: Composite eyes to screen, then blend HUD on both halves
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private GuiRenderState guiRenderState;

    @Shadow
    public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$inStereoRender = false;

    /**
     * Intercept render to implement 5-phase stereo.
     */
    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderHead(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        boolean renderLevel,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) {
            return;
        }

        // Don't intercept if not in game
        if (minecraft.level == null || !renderLevel) {
            return;
        }

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;

        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

    /**
     * 5-Phase stereo rendering.
     */
    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        // Get actual main render target (bypass our override)
        StereoRenderer.setBypassMainTargetOverride(true);
        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        StereoRenderer.setBypassMainTargetOverride(false);

        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;

        // Ensure FBOs exist
        StereoRenderer.ensureFramebuffers(fullWidth, fullHeight);

        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(true);

        // === PHASE 4: Render world for each eye ===
        // Left eye
        StereoRenderer.clearFbo(StereoRenderer.getLeftEyeFbo());
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.LEFT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(true);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);

        // Right eye
        StereoRenderer.clearFbo(StereoRenderer.getRightEyeFbo());
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.RIGHT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(true);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);

        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);

        // === PHASE 5: Composite to main screen ===
        // Copy eye FBOs to main screen halves
        StereoRenderer.compositeEyesToScreen(mainTarget);

        // === PHASE 3: Render HUD at half width ===
        // HUD renders to main target (left half only due to faked width)
        // Then we copy left half to right half
        beeeye$renderHud(deltaTracker, mainTarget);
    }

    /**
     * Render HUD at faked half-width, then copy to right half.
     */
    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderHud(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, RenderTarget mainTarget) {
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(true);

        // Get mouse coordinates (already scaled to half width)
        int mouseX = (int) minecraft.mouseHandler.getScaledXPos(minecraft.getWindow());
        int mouseY = (int) minecraft.mouseHandler.getScaledYPos(minecraft.getWindow());

        // Reset GUI state and create graphics
        guiRenderState.reset();
        GuiGraphics guiGraphics = new GuiGraphics(
            minecraft,
            guiRenderState,
            mouseX,
            mouseY
        );

        // GUI renders at faked half-width (MixinWindow)
        // It draws to left half of screen
        minecraft.gui.render(guiGraphics, deltaTracker);

        StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(false);

        // Copy left half to right half
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int halfWidth = StereoRenderer.getFakedWidth();
        int height = mainTarget.height;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        // Copy left half HUD to right half
        StereoRenderer.copyToScreen(
            mainTarget, mainTarget,
            halfWidth + shift, 0,  // dst: right half
            0, 0,                   // src: left half
            halfWidth - shift, height
        );
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * Override getMainRenderTarget to redirect world rendering to eye FBOs.
 * 
 * During stereo world rendering:
 * - LEFT eye -> returns left eye FBO
 * - RIGHT eye -> returns right eye FBO
 * 
 * During HUD/UI rendering:
 * - Returns actual main target (renders to screen)
 */
@Mixin(Minecraft.class)
public class MixinMinecraft {

    @Inject(method = "getMainRenderTarget", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$overrideRenderTarget(CallbackInfoReturnable<RenderTarget> cir) {
        // Allow bypass to get actual main target
        if (StereoRenderer.shouldBypassMainTargetOverride()) {
            return;
        }

        // Only override during stereo world rendering
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || !StereoRenderer.isRenderingWorld()) {
            return;
        }

        StereoRenderer.Eye eye = StereoRenderer.getCurrentEye();
        if (eye != null) {
            RenderTarget fbo = StereoRenderer.getEyeFbo(eye);
            if (fbo != null) {
                cir.setReturnValue(fbo);
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.Gui;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * GUI/HUD rendering in stereo mode.
 * 
 * Skip GUI during world rendering passes (it's rendered separately after composite).
 * With faked width, GUI renders at half width automatically.
 */
@Mixin(Gui.class)
public abstract class MixinGui {

    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$skipDuringWorldRender(
        GuiGraphics graphics,
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        // Skip GUI during world rendering - it renders after composite
        if (Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() && StereoRenderer.isRenderingWorld()) {
            ci.cancel();
        }
    }
}

## Beeeye Development Notes

### Current Implementation: 5-Phase Stereo Rendering

**Status**: Compiles, ready for testing

#### Architecture

**Phase 1**: Fake screen width to half (MixinWindow)
- `getWidth()`, `getScreenWidth()`, `getGuiScaledWidth()` return half width
- Only when `!renderingWorld` - world renders at full resolution

**Phase 2-3**: HUD Buffer (deferred)
- HUD renders after world composite
- Renders at half width to left half of screen
- Copies to right half

**Phase 4**: True Stereo World Rendering
- Left eye renders to `leftEyeFbo` with negative camera offset
- Right eye renders to `rightEyeFbo` with positive camera offset
- Camera offset applied in MixinCamera via `move(0, 0, offset)`

**Phase 5**: Composite & HUD Overlay
- Eye FBOs composited to main screen (left|right)
- HUD rendered at half width, copied to both halves

#### Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `StereoRenderer.java` | State management, FBOs, composite logic |
| `MixinGameRenderer.java` | Main render loop, 5-phase orchestration |
| `MixinMinecraft.java` | Redirects `getMainRenderTarget()` to eye FBOs |
| `MixinWindow.java` | Fakes width for UI compatibility |
| `MixinCamera.java` | Applies eye offset to camera position |
| `MixinGui.java` | Skips GUI during world render pass |
| `ScreenRenderHandler.java` | Copies screens (inventory) to right half |

#### Configuration

- `eyeDistance`: 0.25 blocks (default), range 0.01-1.0
- `screenShift`: 0 pixels, horizontal split line adjustment
- `interfaceShift`: 0 pixels, GUI placement offset

#### Known Issues / Limitations

1. **Frame Graph Caching**: Minecraft 1.21's frame graph caches render targets at frame start. The `getMainRenderTarget()` override may not work for all render passes.

2. **Chunk Visibility**: `visibleSections` is computed once per frame based on camera position. May need invalidation between eye passes for true stereo.

3. **Copy Parameter Order**: `copyTextureToTexture` signature is `(src, dst, mipLevel, dstX, dstY, srcX, srcY, width, height)` - destination coords before source.

#### Testing Checklist

- [ ] Toggle stereo with `~` key
- [ ] Both eyes show world with parallax
- [ ] HUD appears on both halves
- [ ] Inventory/screens work correctly
- [ ] Crosshair has convergence offset
- [ ] No crashes on window resize

## Assistant

I see the logs show stereo is being enabled/disabled, and FBOs are created. The problem is confirmed - the world isn't rendering to our FBOs. This is the Frame Graph issue mentioned in MEMO.md.

The key insight from the previous research: **Minecraft 1.21's `LevelRenderer` imports the render target via `FrameGraphBuilder.importExternal()` at frame start**, before our mixin can redirect it. 

Let me try a different approach - instead of trying to redirect where the world renders, we'll:
1. Let the world render normally to the main target
2. Copy the rendered result to our eye FBOs with the camera offset applied

But wait - the camera offset IS working (you said head bumping works). The issue is the **second eye render** isn't happening, and the world view isn't responding to camera rotation.

Let me add debug logging and investigate the actual render flow:

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.CommandEncoder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.render.state.GuiRenderState;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * Stereo Rendering - Simplified Approach:
 * 
 * Since Minecraft 1.21's Frame Graph caches the render target at frame start,
 * we cannot redirect where `renderLevel()` outputs.
 * 
 * Instead:
 * 1. Render world once (LEFT eye offset applied by MixinCamera)
 * 2. Copy the result to left half of screen
 * 3. Render world again (RIGHT eye offset)
 * 4. Copy to right half of screen
 * 5. Render HUD at half-width, copy to both halves
 * 
 * The world renders to the main target each time, we just copy afterward.
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private GuiRenderState guiRenderState;

    @Shadow
    public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$inStereoRender = false;

    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderHead(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        boolean renderLevel,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) {
            return;
        }

        if (minecraft.level == null || !renderLevel) {
            return;
        }

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;

        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        // Ensure FBOs exist (for width faking)
        StereoRenderer.ensureFramebuffers(fullWidth, fullHeight);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(true);

        GpuTexture mainTex = mainTarget.getColorTexture();
        if (mainTex == null) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.warn("Main target has no color texture");
            return;
        }

        // === LEFT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.LEFT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(true);
        
        // Clear and render world with left eye offset
        beeeye$clearMainTarget(mainTarget);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);

        // Copy rendered world to left eye FBO
        RenderTarget leftFbo = StereoRenderer.getLeftEyeFbo();
        if (leftFbo != null && leftFbo.getColorTexture() != null) {
            CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
            // Copy center portion of main target to left FBO
            // Main target is full width, we want the center (where player looks)
            int srcX = halfWidth / 2; // Start from 1/4 of screen
            encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                mainTex, leftFbo.getColorTexture(),
                0,          // mipLevel
                0, 0,       // dst position (fill entire FBO)
                srcX, 0,    // src position (center of main target)
                halfWidth, fullHeight
            );
        }

        // === RIGHT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.RIGHT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(true);
        
        // Clear and render world with right eye offset
        beeeye$clearMainTarget(mainTarget);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);

        // Copy rendered world to right eye FBO
        RenderTarget rightFbo = StereoRenderer.getRightEyeFbo();
        if (rightFbo != null && rightFbo.getColorTexture() != null) {
            CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
            int srcX = halfWidth / 2;
            encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                mainTex, rightFbo.getColorTexture(),
                0,
                0, 0,
                srcX, 0,
                halfWidth, fullHeight
            );
        }

        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);

        // === COMPOSITE TO SCREEN ===
        // Clear main target and copy both eyes
        beeeye$clearMainTarget(mainTarget);
        
        CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        
        // Left eye FBO -> left half of screen
        if (leftFbo != null && leftFbo.getColorTexture() != null) {
            int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth + shift, halfWidth);
            encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                leftFbo.getColorTexture(), mainTex,
                0,
                0, 0,           // dst: left edge
                0, 0,           // src: from FBO start
                copyWidth, fullHeight
            );
        }
        
        // Right eye FBO -> right half of screen
        if (rightFbo != null && rightFbo.getColorTexture() != null) {
            int dstX = halfWidth + shift;
            int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth - shift, fullWidth - dstX);
            if (copyWidth > 0) {
                encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                    rightFbo.getColorTexture(), mainTex,
                    0,
                    dstX, 0,        // dst: right half
                    0, 0,           // src: from FBO start
                    copyWidth, fullHeight
                );
            }
        }

        // === RENDER HUD ===
        beeeye$renderHud(deltaTracker, mainTarget);
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$clearMainTarget(RenderTarget target) {
        GpuTexture colorTex = target.getColorTexture();
        GpuTexture depthTex = target.getDepthTexture();
        if (colorTex == null) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        if (depthTex != null) {
            encoder.clearColorAndDepthTextures(colorTex, 0, depthTex, 1.0);
        } else {
            encoder.clearColorTexture(colorTex, 0);
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderHud(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, RenderTarget mainTarget) {
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(true);

        int mouseX = (int) minecraft.mouseHandler.getScaledXPos(minecraft.getWindow());
        int mouseY = (int) minecraft.mouseHandler.getScaledYPos(minecraft.getWindow());

        guiRenderState.reset();
        GuiGraphics guiGraphics = new GuiGraphics(
            minecraft,
            guiRenderState,
            mouseX,
            mouseY
        );

        // GUI renders at faked half-width (MixinWindow)
        minecraft.gui.render(guiGraphics, deltaTracker);

        StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(false);

        // Copy left half HUD to right half
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int halfWidth = StereoRenderer.getFakedWidth();
        int height = mainTarget.height;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        GpuTexture mainTex = mainTarget.getColorTexture();
        if (mainTex == null) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth - shift, fullWidth - (halfWidth + shift));
        if (copyWidth > 0) {
            encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                mainTex, mainTex,
                0,
                halfWidth + shift, 0,   // dst: right half
                0, 0,                    // src: left half
                copyWidth, height
            );
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.CommandEncoder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.render.state.GuiRenderState;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * Simplified Stereo Rendering:
 * 
 * 1. Render world once with LEFT eye offset
 * 2. Copy full main target to left half of screen
 * 3. Render world again with RIGHT eye offset  
 * 4. Copy to right half of screen
 * 5. Render HUD at half width, copy to both halves
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private GuiRenderState guiRenderState;

    @Shadow
    public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$inStereoRender = false;

    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderHead(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        boolean renderLevel,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) {
            return;
        }

        if (minecraft.level == null || !renderLevel) {
            return;
        }

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;

        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
            e.printStackTrace();
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        // Ensure FBOs exist
        StereoRenderer.ensureFramebuffers(fullWidth, fullHeight);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(true);

        RenderTarget leftFbo = StereoRenderer.getLeftEyeFbo();
        RenderTarget rightFbo = StereoRenderer.getRightEyeFbo();
        
        GpuTexture mainTex = mainTarget.getColorTexture();
        if (mainTex == null) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.warn("Main target has no color texture");
            return;
        }

        // === LEFT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.LEFT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(true);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);

        // Copy center of main target to left FBO
        if (leftFbo != null) {
            GpuTexture leftTex = leftFbo.getColorTexture();
            if (leftTex != null) {
                CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
                // Copy from center of full-width render to half-width FBO
                // srcX = halfWidth/2 to get the center portion
                int srcX = halfWidth / 2;
                int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth, fullWidth - srcX);
                encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                    mainTex, leftTex,
                    0,              // mipLevel
                    0, 0,           // dstX, dstY
                    srcX, 0,        // srcX, srcY
                    copyWidth, fullHeight
                );
            }
        }

        // === RIGHT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.RIGHT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(true);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);

        // Copy center of main target to right FBO
        if (rightFbo != null) {
            GpuTexture rightTex = rightFbo.getColorTexture();
            if (rightTex != null) {
                CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
                int srcX = halfWidth / 2;
                int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth, fullWidth - srcX);
                encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                    mainTex, rightTex,
                    0,
                    0, 0,
                    srcX, 0,
                    copyWidth, fullHeight
                );
            }
        }

        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);

        // === COMPOSITE: Copy FBOs to main target halves ===
        CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        
        // Clear main target first
        GpuTexture depthTex = mainTarget.getDepthTexture();
        if (depthTex != null) {
            encoder.clearColorAndDepthTextures(mainTex, 0, depthTex, 1.0);
        } else {
            encoder.clearColorTexture(mainTex, 0);
        }
        
        // Left FBO -> left half of screen
        if (leftFbo != null && leftFbo.getColorTexture() != null) {
            int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth + shift, halfWidth);
            encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                leftFbo.getColorTexture(), mainTex,
                0,
                0, 0,           // dst: left edge of screen
                0, 0,           // src: from FBO
                copyWidth, fullHeight
            );
        }
        
        // Right FBO -> right half of screen
        if (rightFbo != null && rightFbo.getColorTexture() != null) {
            int dstX = halfWidth + shift;
            int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth - shift, fullWidth - dstX);
            if (copyWidth > 0) {
                encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                    rightFbo.getColorTexture(), mainTex,
                    0,
                    dstX, 0,        // dst: right half of screen
                    0, 0,           // src: from FBO
                    copyWidth, fullHeight
                );
            }
        }

        // === RENDER HUD ===
        beeeye$renderHud(deltaTracker, mainTarget);
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderHud(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, RenderTarget mainTarget) {
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(true);

        int mouseX = (int) minecraft.mouseHandler.getScaledXPos(minecraft.getWindow());
        int mouseY = (int) minecraft.mouseHandler.getScaledYPos(minecraft.getWindow());

        guiRenderState.reset();
        GuiGraphics guiGraphics = new GuiGraphics(
            minecraft,
            guiRenderState,
            mouseX,
            mouseY
        );

        // GUI renders at faked half-width
        minecraft.gui.render(guiGraphics, deltaTracker);

        StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(false);

        // Copy left half HUD to right half
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int halfWidth = StereoRenderer.getFakedWidth();
        int height = mainTarget.height;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        GpuTexture mainTex = mainTarget.getColorTexture();
        if (mainTex == null) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth - shift, fullWidth - (halfWidth + shift));
        if (copyWidth > 0) {
            encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                mainTex, mainTex,
                0,
                halfWidth + shift, 0,
                0, 0,
                copyWidth, height
            );
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.CommandEncoder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.render.state.GuiRenderState;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * Simple Stereo: Render world once, copy left half to right half.
 * Camera offset gives parallax via MixinCamera.
 * 
 * This is "mono world + stereo HUD" - both eyes see same world view
 * but with camera slightly offset for depth.
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private GuiRenderState guiRenderState;

    @Shadow
    public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$inStereoRender = false;

    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderHead(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        boolean renderLevel,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) {
            return;
        }

        if (minecraft.level == null || !renderLevel) {
            return;
        }

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;

        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
            e.printStackTrace();
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        StereoRenderer.ensureFramebuffers(fullWidth, fullHeight);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(true);

        // Render world with LEFT eye camera offset
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.LEFT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(true);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);

        // Copy left half of rendered world to right half
        // This gives side-by-side output (both eyes see same view)
        GpuTexture mainTex = mainTarget.getColorTexture();
        if (mainTex != null) {
            CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
            int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth - shift, fullWidth - (halfWidth + shift));
            if (copyWidth > 0) {
                encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                    mainTex, mainTex,
                    0,                      // mipLevel
                    halfWidth + shift, 0,   // dstX, dstY (right half)
                    0, 0,                   // srcX, srcY (left half)
                    copyWidth, fullHeight
                );
            }
        }

        // Render HUD at faked half-width, then copy to right
        beeeye$renderHud(deltaTracker, mainTarget);
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderHud(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, RenderTarget mainTarget) {
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(true);

        int mouseX = (int) minecraft.mouseHandler.getScaledXPos(minecraft.getWindow());
        int mouseY = (int) minecraft.mouseHandler.getScaledYPos(minecraft.getWindow());

        guiRenderState.reset();
        GuiGraphics guiGraphics = new GuiGraphics(
            minecraft,
            guiRenderState,
            mouseX,
            mouseY
        );

        minecraft.gui.render(guiGraphics, deltaTracker);

        StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(false);

        // Copy HUD from left half to right half
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int halfWidth = StereoRenderer.getFakedWidth();
        int height = mainTarget.height;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        GpuTexture mainTex = mainTarget.getColorTexture();
        if (mainTex == null) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth - shift, fullWidth - (halfWidth + shift));
        if (copyWidth > 0) {
            encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                mainTex, mainTex,
                0,
                halfWidth + shift, 0,
                0, 0,
                copyWidth, height
            );
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.CommandEncoder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.render.state.GuiRenderState;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private GuiRenderState guiRenderState;

    @Shadow
    public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
    
    @Unique
    private int beeeye$frameCount = 0;

    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderHead(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        boolean renderLevel,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) {
            return;
        }

        if (minecraft.level == null || !renderLevel) {
            return;
        }

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;

        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
            e.printStackTrace();
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        beeeye$frameCount++;
        boolean debug = (beeeye$frameCount % 300 == 1); // Log every 5 seconds at 60fps
        
        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Stereo frame #{}: mainTarget={}x{}, halfWidth={}, shift={}", 
                beeeye$frameCount, fullWidth, fullHeight, halfWidth, shift);
        }

        StereoRenderer.ensureFramebuffers(fullWidth, fullHeight);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(true);

        // Render world with LEFT eye camera offset
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.LEFT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(true);
        
        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Rendering world with eye={}, offset={}", 
                StereoRenderer.getCurrentEye(), StereoRenderer.getEyeOffset());
        }
        
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);

        // Copy left half to right half
        GpuTexture mainTex = mainTarget.getColorTexture();
        if (mainTex != null) {
            if (debug) {
                Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Copying left half to right: mainTex={}x{}", 
                    mainTex.getWidth(0), mainTex.getHeight(0));
            }
            
            CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
            int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth - shift, fullWidth - (halfWidth + shift));
            
            if (debug) {
                Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Copy params: dstX={}, srcX=0, copyWidth={}, height={}", 
                    halfWidth + shift, copyWidth, fullHeight);
            }
            
            if (copyWidth > 0) {
                encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                    mainTex, mainTex,
                    0,
                    halfWidth + shift, 0,
                    0, 0,
                    copyWidth, fullHeight
                );
            }
        } else {
            if (debug) {
                Beeeye.LOGGER.warn("mainTex is NULL!");
            }
        }

        // Render HUD
        beeeye$renderHud(deltaTracker, mainTarget, debug);
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderHud(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, RenderTarget mainTarget, boolean debug) {
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(true);

        int mouseX = (int) minecraft.mouseHandler.getScaledXPos(minecraft.getWindow());
        int mouseY = (int) minecraft.mouseHandler.getScaledYPos(minecraft.getWindow());

        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Rendering HUD: fakedWidth={}, mouseX={}, mouseY={}", 
                StereoRenderer.getFakedWidth(), mouseX, mouseY);
        }

        guiRenderState.reset();
        GuiGraphics guiGraphics = new GuiGraphics(
            minecraft,
            guiRenderState,
            mouseX,
            mouseY
        );

        minecraft.gui.render(guiGraphics, deltaTracker);

        StereoRenderer.setRenderingHud(false);

        // Copy HUD to right half
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int halfWidth = StereoRenderer.getFakedWidth();
        int height = mainTarget.height;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        GpuTexture mainTex = mainTarget.getColorTexture();
        if (mainTex == null) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth - shift, fullWidth - (halfWidth + shift));
        if (copyWidth > 0) {
            encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                mainTex, mainTex,
                0,
                halfWidth + shift, 0,
                0, 0,
                copyWidth, height
            );
        }
    }
}

## GameRenderer in Minecraft 1.21

The `GameRenderer` class is annotated with `@Environment(CLIENT)` and extends `Object`, implementing `TrackedWaypoint.PitchProvider` and `AutoCloseable`.

### The `renderLevel` Method

In Minecraft's rendering system, the `GameRenderer` class has a `renderLevel` method with the signature: `public void renderLevel(float p_109090_, long p_109091_, PoseStack p_109092_)` (this is from version 1.18.2, but the structure is similar).

For newer versions (1.21.5+), `renderLevel` now takes in a `GpuBufferSlice`, the fog vector, and whether the current position is foggy instead of the `GameRenderer`.

### Key Changes in 1.21

`net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer#MAX_BLUR_RADIUS` is now public and an integer.(no content)There have been a number of rendering changes in 1.21. The vertex system has received a major overhaul, almost being completely rewritten, though most of the codebase has some analogue to its previous version in different locations.

### Rendering System Overview

Since the camera is conceptualized as a single point, a depth of 0.05000000074505806f blocks is used to define a rectangular area to be rendered.

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.CommandEncoder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.render.state.GuiRenderState;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * Stereo rendering - inject AFTER normal render to copy left half to right.
 * 
 * The normal render pipeline runs with LEFT eye offset (via MixinCamera).
 * After it completes, we copy the left half to the right half.
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$frameCount = 0;

    /**
     * Before render: set up stereo state so MixinCamera applies offset.
     */
    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("HEAD"))
    private void beeeye$onRenderHead(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        boolean renderLevel,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled()) {
            return;
        }

        if (minecraft.level == null || !renderLevel) {
            return;
        }

        // Set up stereo state - LEFT eye for the main render pass
        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        StereoRenderer.ensureFramebuffers(mainTarget.width, mainTarget.height);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(true);
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.LEFT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(true);
    }

    /**
     * After render: copy left half to right half for side-by-side output.
     */
    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("RETURN"))
    private void beeeye$onRenderReturn(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        boolean renderLevel,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled()) {
            return;
        }

        if (minecraft.level == null || !renderLevel) {
            return;
        }

        beeeye$frameCount++;
        boolean debug = (beeeye$frameCount % 300 == 1);

        // Clean up stereo state
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingWorld(false);
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);

        // Copy left half to right half
        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        GpuTexture mainTex = mainTarget.getColorTexture();
        if (mainTex == null) {
            if (debug) Beeeye.LOGGER.warn("mainTex is NULL in RETURN");
            return;
        }

        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Stereo frame #{}: copying left half to right. mainTex={}x{}", 
                beeeye$frameCount, mainTex.getWidth(0), mainTex.getHeight(0));
        }

        CommandEncoder encoder = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        int copyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth - shift, fullWidth - (halfWidth + shift));
        
        if (copyWidth > 0) {
            encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
                mainTex, mainTex,
                0,                      // mipLevel
                halfWidth + shift, 0,   // dstX, dstY (right half)
                0, 0,                   // srcX, srcY (left half)
                copyWidth, fullHeight
            );
            
            if (debug) {
                Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Copy done: dstX={}, copyWidth={}", halfWidth + shift, copyWidth);
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;

import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.Gui;

/**

/**
 * Fake window width to half during stereo mode.
 * This makes all UI/interfaces render at half width.
 */
@Mixin(Window.class)
public class MixinWindow {

    @Shadow
    private int framebufferWidth;

    @Shadow

    /**
     * Fake framebuffer width to half.
     */
    @Inject(method = "getWidth", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$fakeWidth(CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if (StereoRenderer.shouldFakeWidth() && !StereoRenderer.isRenderingWorld()) {
            cir.setReturnValue(StereoRenderer.getFakedWidth());
        }

    /**
