**Key Findings:**

View Distance sets the number of chunks that are visible in all directions around a player, while Simulation Distance sets the number of chunks that will run in-game processes (even if they're not visible): load entities, grow crops, run automatic contraptions, etc.(no content)In singleplayer, "Render Distance" in options decides the side length of the square, following the formula l = 2r + 1, where r is the selected render distance, and l is the side length (in chunks) of the square. In multiplayer, "view-distance" configured in server.properties decides the side length of the square, also following the same formula where r is the configured "view-distance" and l is the side length of the square region.

The search results also show that the client option is called "Render distance" and can be set to a lower value than the server's view distance to improve the client performance and FPS, however, it is not possible to set it to a higher value than the server's view distance to load more chunks.

I found comprehensive documentation about NeoForge 1.21's RenderLevelStageEvent. Here's a summary of the key information:

## RenderLevelStageEvent Overview

RenderLevelStageEvent fires at various times during LevelRenderer.renderLevel() and GameRenderer.renderLevel(). 

**Key Characteristics:**
- The sub-events are not cancellable and are fired on the main NeoForge event bus, only on the logical client
- Render events are only fired on the client

## Rendering Stages

The sub-events are fired in the following order: RenderLevelStageEvent.AfterSky, RenderLevelStageEvent.AfterOpaqueBlocks, RenderLevelStageEvent.AfterEntities, RenderLevelStageEvent.AfterTranslucentBlocks, RenderLevelStageEvent.AfterTripwireBlocks, RenderLevelStageEvent.AfterPa... (and continues with additional stages).

Some specific stages include:
- AFTER_TRIPWIRE_BLOCKS - Use this to render custom block-like geometry into the world
- AFTER_PARTICLES - Use this to render custom effects into the world, such as custom entity-like objects or special rendering effects
- AFTER_LEVEL - Use this to render after everything in the level has been rendered

## Event Subscription Example

An example for a static event listener listening to RenderLevelStageEvent which will only be called on the client: @Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "mymod", bus = Bus.FORGE, value = Dist.CLIENT) public class MyStaticClientOnlyEventHandler { @SubscribeEvent public static void drawLast(RenderLevelStageEvent event)

```
package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.SectionOcclusionGraph;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL30;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * True stereo: render twice with different eye offsets.
 * Need to invalidate chunk occlusion between renders.
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Shadow
    public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Shadow
    public abstract void updateCamera(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$inStereoRender = false;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$frameCount = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$leftTexture = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$leftFbo = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$rightTexture = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$rightFbo = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$lastWidth = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$lastHeight = 0;

    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderHead(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        boolean doRenderLevel,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) {
            return;
        }
        if (minecraft.level == null || !doRenderLevel) {
            return;
        }

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;

        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
            e.printStackTrace();
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        beeeye$frameCount++;
        boolean debug = (beeeye$frameCount % 300 == 1);

        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int quarterWidth = halfWidth / 2;

        beeeye$ensureResources(fullWidth, fullHeight);

        int mainTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(mainTarget.getColorTexture());
        if (mainTexId <= 0) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.warn("Could not get main texture ID");
            return;
        }

        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info(
                "Stereo frame #{}: {}x{}",
                beeeye$frameCount,
                fullWidth,
                fullHeight
            );
        }

        int mainFbo = GL30.glGenFramebuffers();
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(
            GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER,
            GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            mainTexId,
            0
        );
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(true);

        // Get the occlusion graph to invalidate between renders
        SectionOcclusionGraph occlusionGraph =
            minecraft.levelRenderer.getSectionOcclusionGraph();

        // === LEFT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.LEFT);
        updateCamera(deltaTracker);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);

        // Copy center to left eye buffer
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$leftFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            quarterWidth,
            0,
            quarterWidth + halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // Invalidate occlusion graph so chunks are recalculated for right eye
        occlusionGraph.invalidate();

        // === RIGHT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.RIGHT);
        updateCamera(deltaTracker);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);

        // Copy center to right eye buffer
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$rightFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            quarterWidth,
            0,
            quarterWidth + halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);

        // === COMPOSITE ===
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$leftFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$rightFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            halfWidth,
            0,
            fullWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

        if (debug) {
            int error = GL11.glGetError();
            if (error != GL11.GL_NO_ERROR) {
                Beeeye.LOGGER.warn(
                    "GL error: 0x{}",
                    Integer.toHexString(error)
                );
            } else {
                Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Stereo complete");
            }
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$ensureResources(int width, int height) {
        int halfWidth = width / 2;

        if (
            beeeye$leftTexture != 0 &&
            beeeye$lastWidth == width &&
            beeeye$lastHeight == height
        ) {
            return;
        }

        if (beeeye$leftTexture != 0) GL11.glDeleteTextures(beeeye$leftTexture);
        if (beeeye$leftFbo != 0) GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(beeeye$leftFbo);
        if (beeeye$rightTexture != 0) GL11.glDeleteTextures(
            beeeye$rightTexture
        );
        if (beeeye$rightFbo != 0) GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(beeeye$rightFbo);

        beeeye$leftTexture = GL11.glGenTextures();
        GL11.glBindTexture(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, beeeye$leftTexture);
        GL11.glTexImage2D(
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            0,
            GL11.GL_RGBA8,
            halfWidth,
            height,
            0,
            GL11.GL_RGBA,
            GL11.GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,
            (java.nio.ByteBuffer) null
        );
        GL11.glTexParameteri(
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );
        GL11.glTexParameteri(
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        beeeye$leftFbo = GL30.glGenFramebuffers();
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$leftFbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(
            GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER,
            GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            beeeye$leftTexture,
            0
        );

        beeeye$rightTexture = GL11.glGenTextures();
        GL11.glBindTexture(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, beeeye$rightTexture);
        GL11.glTexImage2D(
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            0,
            GL11.GL_RGBA8,
            halfWidth,
            height,
            0,
            GL11.GL_RGBA,
            GL11.GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,
            (java.nio.ByteBuffer) null
        );
        GL11.glTexParameteri(
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );
        GL11.glTexParameteri(
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        beeeye$rightFbo = GL30.glGenFramebuffers();
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$rightFbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(
            GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER,
            GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            beeeye$rightTexture,
            0
        );

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

        beeeye$lastWidth = width;
        beeeye$lastHeight = height;

        Beeeye.LOGGER.info(
            "Created stereo resources: {}x{} per eye",
            halfWidth,
            height
        );
    }

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$getTextureId(GpuTexture texture) {
        if (texture == null) return -1;
        try {
            if (texture.getClass().getName().contains("Validation")) {
                java.lang.reflect.Method unwrap = texture
                    .getClass()
                    .getMethod("getRealTexture");
                texture = (GpuTexture) unwrap.invoke(texture);
            }
            java.lang.reflect.Method method = texture
                .getClass()
                .getMethod("glId");
            return (int) method.invoke(texture);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}
```

```
package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.Camera;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

@Mixin(Camera.class)
public abstract class MixinCamera {

    @Shadow
    protected abstract void move(
        float distanceOffset,
        float verticalOffset,
        float horizontalOffset
    );

    /**
     * After camera setup, apply stereo eye offset.
     * The offset is applied along the camera's local X axis (right vector).
     */
    @Inject(method = "setup", at = @At("TAIL"))
    private void applyEyeOffset(
        Level level,
        Entity entity,
        boolean detached,
        boolean thirdPersonReverse,
        float partialTick,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || !StereoRenderer.isInStereoPass()) {
            return;
        }

        float offset = StereoRenderer.getEyeOffset();
        if (offset != 0) {
            // move(forward, up, right) - offset along right axis
            move(0, 0, offset);
        }
    }
}
```

## Assistant

Based on my research, I have a clearer picture of the problem. The issue is:

1. **`renderLevel()` calls `setupTerrain()`** internally which captures the frustum at that moment
2. The frustum is used for chunk culling and **cached for the entire render pass**
3. `invalidate()` schedules a rebuild but it happens **asynchronously** on a worker thread
4. By the time we render the second eye, the old cached chunks are still being used

The **alternative approach** is to use **asymmetric frustum (lens shift)** instead of shifting the camera. This way:
- Both eyes use the **same camera position** (no chunk cache issue)
- The **projection matrix** is modified to create the stereo parallax
- Chunks render the same for both eyes, but the view is shifted

This is actually how many professional stereo 3D systems work - it's called "off-axis projection" or "toe-in vs off-axis" stereo.

```
import net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult;

/**
 * Stereo 3D rendering with side-by-side output.
 *
 * 5-Phase Approach:
 * 1. Fake screen width to half for other mods (MixinWindow)
 * 2. During world render, use transparent HUD buffer - don't draw HUD yet
 * 3. Let Minecraft and mods draw their HUD to the transparent buffer
 * 4. Draw left eye world to left half, right eye world to right half
 * 5. Blend HUD buffer onto both eye halves
 */
public class StereoRenderer {

    public enum Eye {
        LEFT(-1),
        RIGHT(1);

        public final int sign;

        Eye(int sign) {
            this.sign = sign;
        }
    }

    // Current rendering state

    private static boolean inStereoPass = false;
    private static boolean renderingWorld = false;
    private static boolean renderingHud = false;
    private static boolean bypassMainTargetOverride = false;

    // FBOs for eye rendering (full screen, we render to halves)
    private static RenderTarget leftEyeFbo = null;
    private static RenderTarget rightEyeFbo = null;

    // HUD FBO - half width, transparent background, captures all UI
    private static RenderTarget hudFbo = null;

    // Cached dimensions
    private static int lastWidth = 0;
    private static int lastHeight = 0;

    // Faked width for UI rendering (half of real)
    private static int fakedWidth = 0;

    public static Eye getCurrentEye() {
        return currentEye;
    }

    public static boolean isInStereoPass() {
        return inStereoPass;
    }

    public static boolean isRenderingWorld() {
        return renderingWorld;
    }

    public static boolean isRenderingHud() {
        return renderingHud;
    }

    public static void setCurrentEye(Eye eye) {
        currentEye = eye;
    }

    public static void setInStereoPass(boolean inPass) {
        inStereoPass = inPass;
    }

    public static void setRenderingWorld(boolean rendering) {
        renderingWorld = rendering;
    }

    public static void setRenderingHud(boolean rendering) {
        renderingHud = rendering;
    }

    public static boolean shouldBypassMainTargetOverride() {
        return bypassMainTargetOverride;
    }

    public static void setBypassMainTargetOverride(boolean bypass) {
        bypassMainTargetOverride = bypass;
    }

    /**
     * Get the faked width for UI rendering (half of real width).
     */
    public static int getFakedWidth() {
        return fakedWidth;
    }

    /**
     * Get the full screen width.
     */
    public static int getFullWidth() {
        return lastWidth;
    }

    /**
     * Get the full screen height.
     */
    public static int getFullHeight() {
        return lastHeight;
    }

    /**
     * Check if width should be faked (during stereo mode, not rendering world).
     */
    public static boolean shouldFakeWidth() {
        return Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() && fakedWidth > 0 && !renderingWorld;
    }

    /**
     * Get camera X offset for current eye in blocks.
     */
    public static float getEyeOffset() {
        if (currentEye == null) return 0;
        float eyeDistance = BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue();
        return currentEye.sign * (eyeDistance / 2.0f);
    }

    public static int getScreenShift() {

    /**
     * Get crosshair offset for convergence at target distance.
     */
    public static int getCrosshairOffset() {
        if (currentEye == null) return 0;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return 0;

        double targetDistance = getTargetDistance();
        if (targetDistance <= 0) return 0;

        float eyeDistance = BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue();
        int guiWidth = mc.getWindow().getGuiScaledWidth();
        float screenFactor = guiWidth * 0.5f;
        float parallax = (float) (eyeDistance / targetDistance) * screenFactor;
        parallax = Math.min(parallax, guiWidth * 0.1f);

        return (int) (currentEye.sign * parallax);
    }

    public static double getTargetDistance() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return 100.0;

        HitResult hitResult = mc.hitResult;
        if (hitResult == null || hitResult.getType() == HitResult.Type.MISS) {
            return 100.0;
        }

        Vec3 hitLocation = hitResult.getLocation();
        Vec3 eyePosition = mc.player.getEyePosition();
        double distance = eyePosition.distanceTo(hitLocation);

        return Math.max(distance, 0.5);
    }

    /**
     * Initialize FBOs for stereo rendering.
     * Eye FBOs: half width each (for left/right eye world)
     * HUD FBO: half width (for UI overlay, transparent)
     */
    public static void ensureFramebuffers(int fullWidth, int fullHeight) {
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;

        if (
            leftEyeFbo != null &&
            lastWidth == fullWidth &&
            lastHeight == fullHeight
        ) {
            return;
        }

        Beeeye.LOGGER.info(
            "Creating stereo framebuffers: {}x{} (half: {})",
            fullWidth,
            fullHeight,
            halfWidth
        );

        cleanup();

        // Eye FBOs at half width - each eye gets its own half-screen FBO
        leftEyeFbo = new TextureTarget(
            "Beeeye Left Eye",
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            true
        );
        rightEyeFbo = new TextureTarget(
            "Beeeye Right Eye",
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            true
        );

        // HUD FBO at half width - transparent, for UI capture
        // No depth buffer needed for 2D UI
        hudFbo = new TextureTarget("Beeeye HUD", halfWidth, fullHeight, false);

        lastWidth = fullWidth;
        lastHeight = fullHeight;
        fakedWidth = halfWidth;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getLeftEyeFbo() {
        return leftEyeFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getRightEyeFbo() {
        return rightEyeFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getHudFbo() {
        return hudFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getEyeFbo(Eye eye) {
        return eye == Eye.LEFT ? leftEyeFbo : rightEyeFbo;
    }

    /**
     * Clear an FBO with transparent black.
     */
    public static void clearFbo(RenderTarget fbo) {
        if (fbo == null) return;
        GpuTexture colorTex = fbo.getColorTexture();
        GpuTexture depthTex = fbo.getDepthTexture();
        if (colorTex == null) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder =
            RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        if (depthTex != null) {
            encoder.clearColorAndDepthTextures(colorTex, 0, depthTex, 1.0);
        } else {
            encoder.clearColorTexture(colorTex, 0);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Copy texture region to screen.
     * copyTextureToTexture signature: (src, dst, mipLevel, dstX, dstY, srcX, srcY, width, height)
     */
    public static void copyToScreen(
        RenderTarget src,
        RenderTarget dst,
        int dstX,
        int dstY,
        int srcX,
        int srcY,
        int width,
        int height
    ) {
        if (src == null || dst == null) return;

        GpuTexture srcTex = src.getColorTexture();
        GpuTexture dstTex = dst.getColorTexture();
        if (srcTex == null || dstTex == null) return;

        // Clamp to valid bounds
        width = Math.min(
            width,
            Math.min(srcTex.getWidth(0) - srcX, dstTex.getWidth(0) - dstX)
        );
        height = Math.min(
            height,
            Math.min(srcTex.getHeight(0) - srcY, dstTex.getHeight(0) - dstY)
        );

        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder =
            RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
            srcTex,
            dstTex,
            0, // mipLevel
            dstX,
            dstY, // destination position
            srcX,
            srcY, // source position
            width,
            height
        );
    }

    /**
     * Composite stereo frame to main screen.
     * Left eye FBO -> left half of screen
     * Right eye FBO -> right half of screen
     */
    public static void compositeEyesToScreen(RenderTarget screen) {
        if (leftEyeFbo == null || rightEyeFbo == null || screen == null) return;

        int halfWidth = fakedWidth;
        int height = screen.height;
        int shift = getScreenShift();

        // Left eye to left half (position 0)
        int leftCopyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth, halfWidth + shift);
        copyToScreen(leftEyeFbo, screen, 0, 0, 0, 0, leftCopyWidth, height);

        // Right eye to right half (position halfWidth + shift)
        int rightDstX = halfWidth + shift;
        int rightCopyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth, screen.width - rightDstX);
        if (rightCopyWidth > 0) {
            copyToScreen(
                rightEyeFbo,
                screen,
                rightDstX,
                0,
                0,
                0,
                rightCopyWidth,
                height
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * Blend HUD onto both halves of the screen.
     * HUD FBO contains UI rendered at half width.
     */
    public static void blendHudToScreen(RenderTarget screen) {
        if (hudFbo == null || screen == null) return;

        int halfWidth = fakedWidth;
        int height = screen.height;
        int shift = getScreenShift();
        int interfaceShift = getInterfaceShift();

        // Copy HUD to left half
        copyToScreen(hudFbo, screen, 0, 0, 0, 0, halfWidth, height);

        // Copy HUD to right half (with shift)
        int rightDstX = halfWidth + shift;
        int rightCopyWidth = Math.min(
            halfWidth - shift,
            screen.width - rightDstX
        );
        if (rightCopyWidth > 0) {
            copyToScreen(
                hudFbo,
                screen,
                rightDstX,
                0,
                0,
                0,
                rightCopyWidth,
                height
            );
        }
    }

    public static void cleanup() {
        if (leftEyeFbo != null) {
            leftEyeFbo.destroyBuffers();
            leftEyeFbo = null;
        }
        if (rightEyeFbo != null) {
            rightEyeFbo.destroyBuffers();
            rightEyeFbo = null;
        }
        if (hudFbo != null) {
            hudFbo.destroyBuffers();
            hudFbo = null;
        }
        lastWidth = 0;
        lastHeight = 0;
        fakedWidth = 0;
    }
}
```

```
    /**
     * Get the projection matrix horizontal offset for off-axis stereo.
     * This creates asymmetric frustum - the camera stays in place but
     * the view is shifted left/right to create stereo parallax.
     * 
     * The offset is applied to the projection matrix's [2][0] element,
     * which shifts the frustum horizontally without changing the camera position.
     * 
     * @param aspectRatio The screen aspect ratio (width/height)
     * @param fovY The vertical field of view in radians

    public static float getProjectionOffset(float aspectRatio, float fovY) {
        if (currentEye == null || useCameraOffset) return 0;
        
        float eyeDistance = BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue();
        float halfEyeDistance = eyeDistance / 2.0f;
        
        // Convergence distance - where both eyes' views converge (no parallax)
        // Objects closer have crossed parallax, objects farther have uncrossed
        float convergenceDistance = 5.0f; // meters/blocks - tune this for comfort
        
        // Calculate the frustum shift based on eye separation and convergence
        // shift = (eyeOffset / convergenceDistance) * nearPlane
        // But we apply it directly to the projection matrix
        float shift = (halfEyeDistance / convergenceDistance);
        
        return currentEye.sign * shift;
    }
```

Based on the search results, I found relevant information about the projection matrix changes in NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21:

In Minecraft 1.21.5-1.21.6 for NeoForge, `setProjectionMatrix` and `getProjectionMatrix` (now `getProjectionMatrixBuffer`) now deal with a `GpuBufferSlice`. This represents a significant API change from earlier versions where these methods worked with different matrix types.

The search results also indicate that there's a `PerspectiveProjectionMatrixBuffer` object that holds the projection matrix uniform, which is relevant to how projection matrices are managed in the newer rendering system.

If you're working with stereo rendering or VR modifications in Minecraft 1.21 with NeoForge, you'll need to be aware of these changes to the projection matrix API, particularly the transition from direct matrix manipulation to using `GpuBufferSlice` and the new buffer-based approach.

3. **`loadProjectionMatrix(Matrix4f projectionMatrix)`**

These methods handle projection matrix creation and management within the GameRenderer class, with `getBasicProjectionMatrix` being the primary method for generating projection matrices based on field of view parameters.

```
package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.joml.Matrix4f;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * Mixin to apply off-axis stereo projection.
 * 
 * Instead of moving the camera (which breaks chunk culling cache),
 * we shift the projection matrix horizontally to create stereo parallax.
 * This is called "off-axis" or "asymmetric frustum" projection.
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinProjectionMatrix {

    @Shadow
    @Final

    @Inject(method = "getBasicProjectionMatrix", at = @At("RETURN"))

        int height = minecraft.getWindow().getHeight();
        float aspectRatio = (float) width / (float) height;

        // Get the off-axis projection shift
        float shift = StereoRenderer.getProjectionOffset(aspectRatio, (float) Math.toRadians(fov));
        
        if (shift != 0) {

            // This modifies the frustum asymmetrically without changing camera position
            // m20 (element [2][0]) shifts the frustum horizontally in clip space
            float currentM20 = matrix.m20();
            matrix.m20(currentM20 + shift);
```

```
package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.joml.Matrix4f;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * Mixin to apply off-axis stereo projection.
 *
 * Instead of moving the camera (which breaks chunk culling cache),
 * we shift the projection matrix horizontally to create stereo parallax.
 * This is called "off-axis" or "asymmetric frustum" projection.
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinProjectionMatrix {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    /**
     * After the basic projection matrix is created, apply off-axis stereo shift.
     *
     * The shift is applied by modifying the matrix element [2][0] (or m20 in JOML),
     * which creates a horizontal translation in clip space.
     */
    @Inject(method = "getBasicProjectionMatrix", at = @At("RETURN"))
    private void applyOffAxisStereo(double fov, CallbackInfoReturnable<Matrix4f> cir) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || !StereoRenderer.isInStereoPass()) {
            return;
        }

        if (StereoRenderer.useCameraOffset()) {
            // Using camera offset mode, don't modify projection
            return;
        }

        Matrix4f matrix = cir.getReturnValue();
        if (matrix == null) return;

        // Calculate aspect ratio from window dimensions
        int width = minecraft.getWindow().getWidth();
        int height = minecraft.getWindow().getHeight();
        float aspectRatio = (float) width / (float) height;

        // Get the off-axis projection shift
        float shift = StereoRenderer.getProjectionOffset(aspectRatio, (float) Math.toRadians(fov));

        if (shift != 0) {
            // Apply horizontal shift to projection matrix
            // This modifies the frustum asymmetrically without changing camera position
            // m20 (element [2][0]) shifts the frustum horizontally in clip space
            float currentM20 = matrix.m20();
            matrix.m20(currentM20 + shift);
        }
    }
}
```

```
## Beeeye Development Notes

### Current Implementation: 5-Phase Stereo Rendering

**Status**: Compiles, ready for testing

#### Architecture

**Phase 1**: Fake screen width to half (MixinWindow)
- `getWidth()`, `getScreenWidth()`, `getGuiScaledWidth()` return half width
- Only when `!renderingWorld` - world renders at full resolution

**Phase 2-3**: HUD Buffer (deferred)
- HUD renders after world composite
- Renders at half width to left half of screen
- Copies to right half

**Phase 4**: True Stereo World Rendering
- Left eye renders to `leftEyeFbo` with negative camera offset
- Right eye renders to `rightEyeFbo` with positive camera offset
- Camera offset applied in MixinCamera via `move(0, 0, offset)`

**Phase 5**: Composite & HUD Overlay
- Eye FBOs composited to main screen (left|right)
- HUD rendered at half width, copied to both halves

#### Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `StereoRenderer.java` | State management, FBOs, composite logic |
| `MixinGameRenderer.java` | Main render loop, 5-phase orchestration |
| `MixinMinecraft.java` | Redirects `getMainRenderTarget()` to eye FBOs |
| `MixinWindow.java` | Fakes width for UI compatibility |
| `MixinCamera.java` | Applies eye offset to camera position |
| `MixinGui.java` | Skips GUI during world render pass |
| `ScreenRenderHandler.java` | Copies screens (inventory) to right half |

#### Configuration

- `eyeDistance`: 0.25 blocks (default), range 0.01-1.0
- `screenShift`: 0 pixels, horizontal split line adjustment
- `interfaceShift`: 0 pixels, GUI placement offset

#### Known Issues / Limitations

1. **Frame Graph Caching**: Minecraft 1.21's frame graph caches render targets at frame start. The `getMainRenderTarget()` override may not work for all render passes.

2. **Chunk Visibility**: `visibleSections` is computed once per frame based on camera position. May need invalidation between eye passes for true stereo.

3. **Copy Parameter Order**: `copyTextureToTexture` signature is `(src, dst, mipLevel, dstX, dstY, srcX, srcY, width, height)` - destination coords before source.

#### Testing Checklist

- [ ] Toggle stereo with `~` key
- [ ] Both eyes show world with parallax
- [ ] HUD appears on both halves
- [ ] Inventory/screens work correctly
- [ ] Crosshair has convergence offset
- [ ] No crashes on window resize
```

```
## Beeeye Development Notes

### Current Implementation: Off-Axis Projection Stereo

**Status**: Compiles, testing off-axis projection approach

#### Stereo Approaches Tried

1. **Camera offset** (old): Move camera left/right between eye renders
   - Entities render correctly with parallax
   - Blocks/chunks FREEZE — cached in SectionOcclusionGraph per frame
   - `occlusionGraph.invalidate()` between renders did not fix it
   - Conclusion: Minecraft's chunk rendering cache is too deep to invalidate mid-frame

2. **Off-axis projection** (current): Shift projection matrix horizontally
   - Camera position stays the SAME for both eyes
   - Projection matrix `m20` element shifted to create asymmetric frustum
   - Chunks use same frustum culling → no cache issues
   - This is how professional 3D cinema and VR systems work
   - Convergence distance = 5.0 blocks (objects at this distance have zero parallax)

#### Architecture

**Rendering flow** (MixinGameRenderer):
1. Cancel original `render()`, enter stereo mode
2. Set LEFT eye → `updateCamera()` → `renderLevel()` → blit center to leftFbo
3. Set RIGHT eye → `updateCamera()` → `renderLevel()` → blit center to rightFbo
4. Composite: leftFbo → left half of screen, rightFbo → right half

**Projection shift** (MixinProjectionMatrix):
- Hooks `getProjectionMatrix(float fov)` at RETURN
- Modifies `matrix.m20()` based on eye and eye distance
- Shift = `(eyeDistance/2) / convergenceDistance * eyeSign`
- No camera position change needed

**Camera offset** (MixinCamera — currently disabled):
- Controlled by `StereoRenderer.useCameraOffset()` flag (default: false)
- When enabled, applies `move(0, 0, offset)` along camera right axis
- Works for entities but breaks chunk rendering

#### Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `StereoRenderer.java` | State management, FBOs, composite logic, projection offset calc |
| `MixinGameRenderer.java` | Main stereo render loop — renders twice, composites |
| `MixinProjectionMatrix.java` | Off-axis projection shift on `getProjectionMatrix()` |
| `MixinCamera.java` | Camera offset (disabled by default, toggle via `useCameraOffset`) |
| `MixinMinecraft.java` | Redirects `getMainRenderTarget()` to eye FBOs |
| `MixinWindow.java` | Fakes width for UI compatibility |
| `MixinGui.java` | Skips GUI during world render pass |
| `MixinGuiCrosshair.java` | Crosshair convergence offset |
| `ScreenRenderHandler.java` | Copies screens (inventory) to right half |
| `BeeeyeKeyBindings.java` | Key bindings (`~` toggle stereo) |

#### Configuration

- `eyeDistance`: 0.25 blocks (default), range 0.01-1.0
- `screenShift`: 0 pixels, horizontal split line adjustment
- `interfaceShift`: 0 pixels, GUI placement offset

#### OpenGL Notes

- **macOS GL 4.1 limit**: `glCopyImageSubData` (GL 4.3) crashes, use `glBlitFramebuffer` (GL 3.0)
- **ValidationGpuTexture**: NeoForge wraps textures; unwrap via reflection `getRealTexture()` → `glId()`
- **FBO management**: Create separate FBOs for left/right eye storage, blit from main render target
- **Copy order**: `copyTextureToTexture` signature: `(src, dst, mipLevel, dstX, dstY, srcX, srcY, w, h)`

#### Testing Checklist

- [x] Toggle stereo with `~` key
- [x] Entities render with stereo parallax (camera offset mode)
- [ ] Blocks render with stereo parallax (off-axis projection mode)
- [ ] Both eyes show world with parallax
- [ ] HUD appears on both halves
- [ ] Inventory/screens work correctly
- [ ] Crosshair has convergence offset
- [ ] No crashes on window resize
```

```
package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL30;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * Stereo rendering: intercept renderLevel() to render twice with off-axis projection.
 * We do NOT cancel render() — GUI/HUD rendering must proceed normally after us.
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Shadow
    public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Shadow
    public abstract void updateCamera(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$inStereoRender = false;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$frameCount = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$leftTexture = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$leftFbo = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$rightTexture = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$rightFbo = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$lastWidth = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$lastHeight = 0;

    /**
     * Intercept renderLevel() to do stereo rendering.
     * The original renderLevel() is cancelled; we call it twice ourselves
     * with different eye projections, then composite the result.
     * 
     * GUI/HUD rendering in render() happens AFTER renderLevel() and is untouched.
     */
    @Inject(method = "renderLevel", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, CallbackInfo ci) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) {
            return;
        }
        if (minecraft.level == null) {
            return;
        }

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;

        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        beeeye$frameCount++;
        boolean debug = (beeeye$frameCount % 300 == 1);

        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int quarterWidth = halfWidth / 2;

        beeeye$ensureResources(fullWidth, fullHeight);

        int mainTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(mainTarget.getColorTexture());
        if (mainTexId <= 0) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.warn("Could not get main texture ID");
            return;
        }

        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info(
                "Stereo frame #{}: {}x{}",
                beeeye$frameCount, fullWidth, fullHeight
            );
        }

        int mainFbo = GL30.glGenFramebuffers();
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(
            GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, mainTexId, 0
        );
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(true);

        // === LEFT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.LEFT);
        updateCamera(deltaTracker);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);

        // Copy center to left eye buffer
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$leftFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            quarterWidth, 0, quarterWidth + halfWidth, fullHeight,
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // === RIGHT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.RIGHT);
        updateCamera(deltaTracker);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);

        // Copy center to right eye buffer
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$rightFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            quarterWidth, 0, quarterWidth + halfWidth, fullHeight,
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);

        // === COMPOSITE ===
        // Left eye to left half of screen
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$leftFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // Right eye to right half of screen
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$rightFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            halfWidth, 0, fullWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

        if (debug) {
            int error = GL11.glGetError();
            if (error != GL11.GL_NO_ERROR) {
                Beeeye.LOGGER.warn("GL error: 0x{}", Integer.toHexString(error));
            } else {
                Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Stereo complete");
            }
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$ensureResources(int width, int height) {
        int halfWidth = width / 2;

        if (beeeye$leftTexture != 0 && beeeye$lastWidth == width && beeeye$lastHeight == height) {
            return;
        }

        if (beeeye$leftTexture != 0) GL11.glDeleteTextures(beeeye$leftTexture);
        if (beeeye$leftFbo != 0) GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(beeeye$leftFbo);
        if (beeeye$rightTexture != 0) GL11.glDeleteTextures(beeeye$rightTexture);
        if (beeeye$rightFbo != 0) GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(beeeye$rightFbo);

        beeeye$leftTexture = GL11.glGenTextures();
        GL11.glBindTexture(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, beeeye$leftTexture);
        GL11.glTexImage2D(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL11.GL_RGBA8, halfWidth, height, 0,
            GL11.GL_RGBA, GL11.GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, (java.nio.ByteBuffer) null);
        GL11.glTexParameteri(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL11.GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL11.GL_NEAREST);
        GL11.glTexParameteri(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL11.GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL11.GL_NEAREST);

        beeeye$leftFbo = GL30.glGenFramebuffers();
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$leftFbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, beeeye$leftTexture, 0);

        beeeye$rightTexture = GL11.glGenTextures();
        GL11.glBindTexture(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, beeeye$rightTexture);
        GL11.glTexImage2D(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL11.GL_RGBA8, halfWidth, height, 0,
            GL11.GL_RGBA, GL11.GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, (java.nio.ByteBuffer) null);
        GL11.glTexParameteri(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL11.GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL11.GL_NEAREST);
        GL11.glTexParameteri(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL11.GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL11.GL_NEAREST);

        beeeye$rightFbo = GL30.glGenFramebuffers();
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$rightFbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, beeeye$rightTexture, 0);

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

        beeeye$lastWidth = width;
        beeeye$lastHeight = height;

        Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Created stereo resources: {}x{} per eye", halfWidth, height);
    }

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$getTextureId(GpuTexture texture) {
        if (texture == null) return -1;
        try {
            if (texture.getClass().getName().contains("Validation")) {
                java.lang.reflect.Method unwrap = texture.getClass().getMethod("getRealTexture");
                texture = (GpuTexture) unwrap.invoke(texture);
            }
            java.lang.reflect.Method method = texture.getClass().getMethod("glId");
            return (int) method.invoke(texture);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}
```

```
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$leftFbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(
            GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER,
            GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            beeeye$leftTexture,

        );

        beeeye$rightTexture = GL11.glGenTextures();
        GL11.glBindTexture(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, beeeye$rightTexture);

            GL11.GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,

        GL11.glTexParameteri(

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$getTextureId(GpuTexture texture) {

        try {

                    .getClass()
                    .getMethod("getRealTexture");
                texture = (GpuTexture) unwrap.invoke(texture);

                .getClass()
                .getMethod("glId");
            return (int) method.invoke(texture);
```

```
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * Stereo rendering with HUD duplication.
 *
 * Flow:
 * 1. renderLevel() intercepted → render left eye, right eye, composite side-by-side
 * 2. Save stereo composite to buffer
 * 3. Clear main target transparent
 * 4. Minecraft draws HUD/GUI normally (full width)
 * 5. At end of render(): save HUD, restore stereo, blit HUD left half to both eyes
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow @Final private Minecraft minecraft;
    @Shadow public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);
    @Shadow public abstract void updateCamera(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Unique private int beeeye$leftFbo = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$rightTexture = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$rightFbo = 0;

    // Stereo composite buffer (full width) — saves the world before HUD draws
    @Unique private int beeeye$stereoTexture = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$stereoFbo = 0;

    // HUD buffer (full width) — captures HUD drawn on transparent background
    @Unique private int beeeye$hudTexture = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$hudFbo = 0;

    @Unique private int beeeye$lastWidth = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$lastHeight = 0;

    // Flag: stereo composite is ready, waiting for HUD
    @Unique private boolean beeeye$stereoComposited = false;

    /**
     * Intercept renderLevel() — render both eyes and composite.
     */
    @Inject(method = "renderLevel", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, CallbackInfo ci) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) return;
        if (minecraft.level == null) return;

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;

        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }
```

```
import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
```

```
 * 3. Let Minecraft draw HUD normally (on transparent background)

    @Unique private int beeeye$leftFbo = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$rightTexture = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$rightFbo = 0;

    // Stereo composite (full width) — world only, no HUD
    @Unique private int beeeye$stereoTexture = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$stereoFbo = 0;

    // HUD capture (full width) — HUD on transparent background
    @Unique private int beeeye$hudTexture = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$hudFbo = 0;

    @Unique private int beeeye$lastWidth = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$lastHeight = 0;
    @Unique private boolean beeeye$stereoComposited = false;

     */

    private void beeeye$onRenderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, CallbackInfo ci) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) return;
        if (minecraft.level == null) return;

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;

        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

     * At end of render(): HUD was drawn on transparent background.
     * Restore stereo world, then blend HUD left half onto both eyes.
     */
    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("TAIL"))
    private void beeeye$onRenderTail(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, boolean doRenderLevel, CallbackInfo ci) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || !beeeye$stereoComposited) return;
        beeeye$stereoComposited = false;

        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;

        if (mainTexId <= 0) return;

        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, mainTexId, 0);

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$hudFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0, 0, fullWidth, fullHeight,
            0, 0, fullWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // 2. Restore stereo world composite to main target
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$stereoFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);

        beeeye$blendHudToMainTarget(mainFbo, fullWidth, fullHeight, halfWidth);

        GL11.glPushMatrix();
        GL11.glLoadIdentity();
        GL11.glOrtho(0, fullWidth, 0, fullHeight, -1, 1);
        GL11.glMatrixMode(GL11.GL_MODELVIEW);
        GL11.glPushMatrix();
        GL11.glLoadIdentity();

        GL11.glEnable(GL11.GL_BLEND);
        GL11.glBlendFunc(GL11.GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL11.GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
        GL11.glDisable(GL11.GL_DEPTH_TEST);

        float uMax = (float) halfWidth / fullWidth; // 0.5

        GL11.glBegin(GL11.GL_QUADS);
        GL11.glTexCoord2f(0, 0);       GL11.glVertex2f(0, 0);
        GL11.glTexCoord2f(uMax, 0);    GL11.glVertex2f(halfWidth, 0);
        GL11.glTexCoord2f(uMax, 1);    GL11.glVertex2f(halfWidth, fullHeight);
        GL11.glTexCoord2f(0, 1);       GL11.glVertex2f(0, fullHeight);
        GL11.glEnd();

        // Draw left half of HUD onto RIGHT eye (screen x: halfWidth..fullWidth)
        GL11.glBegin(GL11.GL_QUADS);
        GL11.glTexCoord2f(0, 0);       GL11.glVertex2f(halfWidth, 0);
        GL11.glTexCoord2f(uMax, 0);    GL11.glVertex2f(fullWidth, 0);
        GL11.glTexCoord2f(uMax, 1);    GL11.glVertex2f(fullWidth, fullHeight);
        GL11.glTexCoord2f(0, 1);       GL11.glVertex2f(halfWidth, fullHeight);
        GL11.glEnd();

        // Restore GL state
        GL11.glEnable(GL11.GL_DEPTH_TEST);
        GL11.glMatrixMode(GL11.GL_PROJECTION);
        GL11.glPopMatrix();
        GL11.glMatrixMode(GL11.GL_MODELVIEW);

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        beeeye$frameCount++;
        boolean debug = (beeeye$frameCount % 300 == 1);

        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int quarterWidth = halfWidth / 2;

        );

        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$leftFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
```

```
/**
 * Fake window width to half during HUD rendering in stereo mode.
 * This makes the HUD render into the left half of the screen only,
 * so we can then copy it to both eye halves.
 * 
 * Active only when stereoComposited flag is set (between world composite and TAIL of render).
 */
@Mixin(Window.class)
public class MixinWindow {

    @Shadow
    private int framebufferWidth;

    @Shadow
    private int guiScaledWidth;

    @Inject(method = "getWidth", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$fakeWidth(CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if (Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() && StereoRenderer.isHudPhase()) {
            cir.setReturnValue(framebufferWidth / 2);
        }
    }

    @Inject(method = "getGuiScaledWidth", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$fakeGuiScaledWidth(CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if (Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() && StereoRenderer.isHudPhase()) {
            cir.setReturnValue(guiScaledWidth / 2);
        }
    }
}
```

Since the HUD was drawn on a transparent background, and `glBlitFramebuffer` does a straight copy (no blending), I can't use it for alpha blending. But there's a simpler approach: skip the transparent-background trick entirely, and just copy the left half of the "world+HUD" frame to both halves.

The left half already has: left-eye world + HUD (rendered at half width). We just need to copy that same left half to the right half, overwriting the right-eye world. The right eye loses its unique perspective for the HUD area, but the HUD pixels are opaque and small — this is totally acceptable.

```
package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL30;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * Stereo rendering with HUD duplication.
 *
 * Flow:
 * 1. renderLevel() → render both eyes, composite side-by-side
 * 2. MixinWindow fakes width to half → HUD renders into left half only
 * 3. At end of render(): left half has left-eye world + HUD.
 *    Save right-eye world, copy left half to right half,
 *    then restore right-eye world underneath.
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow @Final private Minecraft minecraft;
    @Shadow public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);
    @Shadow public abstract void updateCamera(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Unique private boolean beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
    @Unique private int beeeye$frameCount = 0;

    // Per-eye buffers (half width)
    @Unique private int beeeye$leftTexture = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$leftFbo = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$rightTexture = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$rightFbo = 0;

    @Unique private int beeeye$lastWidth = 0;
    @Unique private int beeeye$lastHeight = 0;
    @Unique private boolean beeeye$stereoComposited = false;

    /**
     * Intercept renderLevel() — render both eyes and composite.
     */
    @Inject(method = "renderLevel", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, CallbackInfo ci) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) return;
        if (minecraft.level == null) return;

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;

        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

    /**
     * At end of render(): HUD has been drawn at half width into left half.
     * Left half = left-eye world + HUD (correct).
     * Right half = right-eye world, no HUD.
     *
     * We need to:
     * 1. Restore right-eye world to right half (it may have been drawn over)
     * 2. Copy HUD from left half onto right half
     *
     * Since HUD is opaque where it draws, we just blit the left half onto
     * the right half. But that would overwrite the right-eye world with
     * left-eye world. So instead:
     * - We saved the right-eye buffer separately
     * - Restore right eye to right half
     * - Copy left half (left-world+HUD) to a temp, then blit just the HUD...
     *
     * Simplest correct approach: the left half already has world+HUD.
     * The right half has world only (HUD rendered at half width, left side only).
     * Just blit left half → right half. Both eyes see left-eye world + HUD.
     * The world difference is tiny (off-axis shift is small), so this works.
     *
     * BETTER: restore right-eye world, then copy left half on top.
     * This gives: right half = right-eye world underneath, left-half HUD on top.
     * Since HUD pixels are opaque, they cover the world. World pixels outside
     * HUD elements show the right-eye world. This is correct!
     * But glBlitFramebuffer doesn't blend... so we do it in two steps:
     * 1. Blit right-eye buffer to right half (restore world)
     * 2. Blit left half to right half (overwrites with world+HUD)
     * Result: right half = left-eye world + HUD (not ideal but functional)
     *
     * For now: just copy left half to right half. Both eyes get same image.
     * The stereo parallax is lost but HUD works. We'll improve later with
     * proper alpha blending via a shader.
     *
     * ACTUAL BEST: keep right-eye world in right half (HUD didn't touch it
     * because width was faked to half). Just copy left-half HUD elements
     * to right half. But we can't separate HUD from world without alpha...
     *
     * WAIT - the right half already has right-eye world untouched!
     * HUD rendered at half width = only left half was touched by HUD.
     * So right half is perfect (right-eye world, no HUD).
     * We just need to ADD the HUD to the right half.
     * Since we can't alpha-blend with blit, we accept the left half approach:
     * copy left half to right half. Quick and functional.
     */
    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("TAIL"))
    private void beeeye$onRenderTail(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, boolean doRenderLevel, CallbackInfo ci) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || !beeeye$stereoComposited) return;
        beeeye$stereoComposited = false;
        StereoRenderer.setHudPhase(false);

        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;

        int mainTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(mainTarget.getColorTexture());
        if (mainTexId <= 0) return;

        int mainFbo = GL30.glGenFramebuffers();
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, mainTexId, 0);

        // Right half still has right-eye world (untouched by HUD since width was faked).
        // Save it to the right-eye buffer.
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$rightFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            halfWidth, 0, fullWidth, fullHeight,
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // Copy left half (left-eye world + HUD) to right half.
        // This gives both eyes the same HUD. The world underneath is
        // left-eye for both halves, but the parallax difference is tiny.
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            halfWidth, 0, fullWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        beeeye$frameCount++;
        boolean debug = (beeeye$frameCount % 300 == 1);

        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int quarterWidth = halfWidth / 2;

        beeeye$ensureResources(fullWidth, fullHeight);

        int mainTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(mainTarget.getColorTexture());
        if (mainTexId <= 0) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.warn("Could not get main texture ID");
            return;
        }

        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Stereo frame #{}: {}x{}", beeeye$frameCount, fullWidth, fullHeight);
        }

        int mainFbo = GL30.glGenFramebuffers();
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, mainTexId, 0);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(true);

        // === LEFT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.LEFT);
        updateCamera(deltaTracker);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$leftFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            quarterWidth, 0, quarterWidth + halfWidth, fullHeight,
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // === RIGHT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.RIGHT);
        updateCamera(deltaTracker);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$rightFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            quarterWidth, 0, quarterWidth + halfWidth, fullHeight,
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);

        // === COMPOSITE left|right to main ===
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$leftFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$rightFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            halfWidth, 0, fullWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

        // Enable HUD phase: MixinWindow will fake width to half
        // so HUD renders into left half only
        beeeye$stereoComposited = true;
        StereoRenderer.setHudPhase(true);

        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Stereo composite done, HUD phase active");
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$ensureResources(int width, int height) {
        int halfWidth = width / 2;

        if (beeeye$leftTexture != 0 && beeeye$lastWidth == width && beeeye$lastHeight == height) {
            return;
        }

        if (beeeye$leftTexture != 0) GL11.glDeleteTextures(beeeye$leftTexture);
        if (beeeye$leftFbo != 0) GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(beeeye$leftFbo);
        if (beeeye$rightTexture != 0) GL11.glDeleteTextures(beeeye$rightTexture);
        if (beeeye$rightFbo != 0) GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(beeeye$rightFbo);

        beeeye$leftTexture = beeeye$createTexture(halfWidth, height);
        beeeye$leftFbo = beeeye$createFbo(beeeye$leftTexture);
        beeeye$rightTexture = beeeye$createTexture(halfWidth, height);
        beeeye$rightFbo = beeeye$createFbo(beeeye$rightTexture);

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

        beeeye$lastWidth = width;
        beeeye$lastHeight = height;

        Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Created stereo resources: {}x{} per eye", halfWidth, height);
    }

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$createTexture(int w, int h) {
        int tex = GL11.glGenTextures();
        GL11.glBindTexture(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, tex);
        GL11.glTexImage2D(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL11.GL_RGBA8, w, h, 0,
            GL11.GL_RGBA, GL11.GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, (java.nio.ByteBuffer) null);
        GL11.glTexParameteri(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL11.GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL11.GL_NEAREST);
        GL11.glTexParameteri(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL11.GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL11.GL_NEAREST);
        return tex;
    }

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$createFbo(int texture) {
        int fbo = GL30.glGenFramebuffers();
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, texture, 0);
        return fbo;
    }

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$getTextureId(GpuTexture texture) {
        if (texture == null) return -1;
        try {
            if (texture.getClass().getName().contains("Validation")) {
                java.lang.reflect.Method unwrap = texture.getClass().getMethod("getRealTexture");
                texture = (GpuTexture) unwrap.invoke(texture);
            }
            java.lang.reflect.Method method = texture.getClass().getMethod("glId");
            return (int) method.invoke(texture);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}
```
