package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.Camera;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.PerspectiveProjectionMatrixBuffer;
import org.joml.Matrix4f;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL30;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * Stereo rendering with HUD duplication via alpha compositing.
 *
 * Plan (from TODO.md):
 * 1. Render left and right eyes into buffers
 * 2. Fill main buffer with transparent
 * 3. Fake width to half — MixinMinecraft redirects getMainRenderTarget() to hudFbo
 * 4. Minecraft and mods draw HUD onto half-width transparent hudFbo
 * 5. Save HUD buffer
 * 6. Restore stereo image to main buffer
 * 7. Alpha-composite HUD onto left eye
 * 8. Alpha-composite HUD onto right eye
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Shadow
    public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Shadow
    public abstract void updateCamera(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Shadow
    public abstract Matrix4f getProjectionMatrix(float fov);

    @Shadow
    public abstract float getFov(
        Camera camera,
        float partialTick,
        boolean useFovSetting
    );

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Camera mainCamera;

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private PerspectiveProjectionMatrixBuffer levelProjectionMatrixBuffer;

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$inStereoRender = false;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$frameCount = 0;

    // Per-eye buffers (half width)
    @Unique
    private int beeeye$leftTexture = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$leftFbo = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$rightTexture = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$rightFbo = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$lastWidth = 0;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$lastHeight = 0;

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$stereoReady = false;

    /**
     * Step 1: Intercept renderLevel() — render both eyes into buffers.
     */
    @Inject(method = "renderLevel", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderLevel(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) return;
        if (minecraft.level == null) return;

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;
        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Steps 5-8: After render() completes, HUD is in hudFbo (half-width, transparent bg).
     * Restore stereo world, alpha-composite HUD onto both halves.
     */
    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("TAIL"))
    private void beeeye$onRenderTail(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        boolean doRenderLevel,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!beeeye$stereoReady) return;
        beeeye$stereoReady = false;
        StereoRenderer.setHudPhase(false);

        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        RenderTarget hudFbo = StereoRenderer.getHudFbo();
        RenderTarget compositeRT = StereoRenderer.getCompositeTarget();
        if (hudFbo == null || compositeRT == null) return;

        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;

        int mainTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(mainTarget.getColorTexture());
        int hudTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(hudFbo.getColorTexture());
        int compositeTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(compositeRT.getColorTexture());
        if (mainTexId <= 0 || hudTexId <= 0 || compositeTexId <= 0) return;

        // Create temp GL FBOs wrapping the RenderTarget textures for glBlitFramebuffer
        int mainGlFbo = beeeye$createFbo(mainTexId);
        int hudGlFbo = beeeye$createFbo(hudTexId);
        int compositeGlFbo = beeeye$createFbo(compositeTexId);

        // Step 6: Restore stereo world to main target
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$leftFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, mainGlFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$rightFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            halfWidth,
            0,
            fullWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // Steps 7-8: Alpha-composite HUD onto both eyes in a single pass.
        // Clear composite to transparent, copy HUD into left half AND right half,
        // then blend once onto main target.
        StereoRenderer.clearFbo(compositeRT);

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, hudGlFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, compositeGlFbo);

        // HUD into left half
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // HUD into right half
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            halfWidth,
            0,
            fullWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);
        compositeRT.blitAndBlendToTexture(mainTarget.getColorTextureView());

        // Cleanup temp GL FBOs
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(mainGlFbo);
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(hudGlFbo);
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(compositeGlFbo);
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        beeeye$frameCount++;
        boolean debug = (beeeye$frameCount % 300 == 1);

        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int quarterWidth = halfWidth / 2;

        beeeye$ensureResources(fullWidth, fullHeight);
        StereoRenderer.ensureFramebuffers(fullWidth, fullHeight);

                fullWidth,
                fullHeight
            );

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(
            GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER,
            GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            mainTexId,
            0
        );

            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // === RIGHT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.RIGHT);
        updateCamera(deltaTracker);
        beeeye$updateProjection(fov);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, beeeye$rightFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            quarterWidth,
            0,
            quarterWidth + halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);

        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(mainFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

        // Step 2: Clear hudFbo to transparent (it's the target during HUD phase)
        StereoRenderer.clearFbo(StereoRenderer.getHudFbo());

        // Step 3: Enable HUD phase — MixinWindow fakes width, MixinMinecraft redirects render target
        beeeye$stereoReady = true;
        StereoRenderer.setHudPhase(true);

        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Stereo eyes saved, HUD phase active");
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$ensureResources(int width, int height) {
        int halfWidth = width / 2;
        if (
            beeeye$leftTexture != 0 &&
            beeeye$lastWidth == width &&
            beeeye$lastHeight == height
        ) return;

        if (beeeye$leftTexture != 0) GL11.glDeleteTextures(beeeye$leftTexture);
        if (beeeye$leftFbo != 0) GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(beeeye$leftFbo);
        if (beeeye$rightTexture != 0) GL11.glDeleteTextures(
            beeeye$rightTexture
        );
        if (beeeye$rightFbo != 0) GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(beeeye$rightFbo);

        beeeye$leftTexture = beeeye$createTexture(halfWidth, height);
        beeeye$leftFbo = beeeye$createFbo(beeeye$leftTexture);
        beeeye$rightTexture = beeeye$createTexture(halfWidth, height);
        beeeye$rightFbo = beeeye$createFbo(beeeye$rightTexture);

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);
        beeeye$lastWidth = width;
        beeeye$lastHeight = height;
        Beeeye.LOGGER.info(
            "Created stereo eye buffers: {}x{} per eye",
            halfWidth,
            height
        );
    }

    /**
     * Recompute projection matrix for current eye and upload to GPU buffer.
     * getProjectionMatrix() triggers our MixinProjectionMatrix which applies
     * the per-eye off-axis shift based on StereoRenderer.getCurrentEye().
     */
    @Unique
    private void beeeye$updateProjection(float fov) {
        Matrix4f projMatrix = getProjectionMatrix(fov);
        levelProjectionMatrixBuffer.getBuffer(projMatrix);
    }

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$createTexture(int w, int h) {
        int tex = GL11.glGenTextures();
        GL11.glBindTexture(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, tex);
        GL11.glTexImage2D(
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            0,
            GL11.GL_RGBA8,
            w,
            h,
            0,
            GL11.GL_RGBA,
            GL11.GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,
            (java.nio.ByteBuffer) null
        );
        GL11.glTexParameteri(
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );
        GL11.glTexParameteri(
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );
        return tex;
    }

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$createFbo(int texture) {
        int fbo = GL30.glGenFramebuffers();
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(
            GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER,
            GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            texture,
            0
        );
        return fbo;
    }

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$getTextureId(GpuTexture texture) {
        if (texture == null) return -1;
        try {
            if (texture.getClass().getName().contains("Validation")) {
                java.lang.reflect.Method unwrap = texture
                    .getClass()
                    .getMethod("getRealTexture");
                texture = (GpuTexture) unwrap.invoke(texture);
            }
            java.lang.reflect.Method method = texture
                .getClass()
                .getMethod("glId");
            return (int) method.invoke(texture);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL30;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * Stereo rendering: each eye renders to its own half-width FBO,
 * then composited to main target. HUD alpha-composited onto both eyes.
 *
 * Key insight: redirect getMainRenderTarget() to eye FBO during renderLevel(),
 * so Minecraft renders directly into half-width buffer with correct aspect ratio.
 * Off-axis projection (MixinProjectionMatrix) provides per-eye parallax.
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Shadow
    public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Shadow
    public abstract void updateCamera(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$inStereoRender = false;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$frameCount = 0;

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$stereoReady = false;

    /**
     * Intercept renderLevel() — render both eyes into separate half-width FBOs.
     */
    @Inject(method = "renderLevel", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, CallbackInfo ci) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) return;
        if (minecraft.level == null) return;

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;
        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingEye(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

    /**
     * After render() completes, HUD is in hudFbo. Restore stereo world,
     * alpha-composite HUD onto both halves.
     */
    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("TAIL"))
    private void beeeye$onRenderTail(DeltaTracker deltaTracker, boolean doRenderLevel, CallbackInfo ci) {
        if (!beeeye$stereoReady) return;
        beeeye$stereoReady = false;
        StereoRenderer.setHudPhase(false);

        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        RenderTarget leftFbo = StereoRenderer.getLeftEyeFbo();
        RenderTarget rightFbo = StereoRenderer.getRightEyeFbo();
        RenderTarget hudFbo = StereoRenderer.getHudFbo();
        RenderTarget compositeRT = StereoRenderer.getCompositeTarget();
        if (leftFbo == null || rightFbo == null || hudFbo == null || compositeRT == null) return;

        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;

        int mainTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(mainTarget.getColorTexture());
        int leftTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(leftFbo.getColorTexture());
        int rightTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(rightFbo.getColorTexture());
        int hudTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(hudFbo.getColorTexture());
        int compositeTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(compositeRT.getColorTexture());
        if (mainTexId <= 0 || leftTexId <= 0 || rightTexId <= 0 || hudTexId <= 0 || compositeTexId <= 0) return;

        // Temp GL FBOs wrapping RenderTarget textures
        int mainGlFbo = beeeye$wrapTexAsFbo(mainTexId);
        int leftGlFbo = beeeye$wrapTexAsFbo(leftTexId);
        int rightGlFbo = beeeye$wrapTexAsFbo(rightTexId);
        int hudGlFbo = beeeye$wrapTexAsFbo(hudTexId);
        int compositeGlFbo = beeeye$wrapTexAsFbo(compositeTexId);

        // Restore stereo world: eye FBOs → main target halves
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, leftGlFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, mainGlFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, rightGlFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            halfWidth, 0, fullWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // Alpha-composite HUD onto both eyes in single pass
        StereoRenderer.clearFbo(compositeRT);

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, hudGlFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, compositeGlFbo);

        // HUD into left half
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // HUD into right half
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0, 0, halfWidth, fullHeight,
            halfWidth, 0, fullWidth, fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);
        compositeRT.blitAndBlendToTexture(mainTarget.getColorTextureView());

        // Cleanup
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(mainGlFbo);
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(leftGlFbo);
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(rightGlFbo);
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(hudGlFbo);
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(compositeGlFbo);
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        beeeye$frameCount++;
        boolean debug = (beeeye$frameCount % 300 == 1);

        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;

        StereoRenderer.ensureFramebuffers(fullWidth, fullHeight);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(true);

        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Stereo frame #{}: {}x{}", beeeye$frameCount, fullWidth, fullHeight);
        }

        // === LEFT EYE ===
        // Redirect getMainRenderTarget() to left eye FBO, fake width to half
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.LEFT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingEye(true);
        StereoRenderer.clearFbo(StereoRenderer.getLeftEyeFbo());
        updateCamera(deltaTracker);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingEye(false);

        // === RIGHT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.RIGHT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingEye(true);
        StereoRenderer.clearFbo(StereoRenderer.getRightEyeFbo());
        updateCamera(deltaTracker);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingEye(false);

        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);

        // Clear hudFbo, enable HUD phase
        StereoRenderer.clearFbo(StereoRenderer.getHudFbo());
        beeeye$stereoReady = true;
        StereoRenderer.setHudPhase(true);

        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Stereo eyes saved, HUD phase active");
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$wrapTexAsFbo(int textureId) {
        int fbo = GL30.glGenFramebuffers();
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(
            GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D, textureId, 0
        );
        return fbo;
    }

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$getTextureId(GpuTexture texture) {
        if (texture == null) return -1;
        try {
            if (texture.getClass().getName().contains("Validation")) {
                java.lang.reflect.Method unwrap = texture.getClass().getMethod("getRealTexture");
                texture = (GpuTexture) unwrap.invoke(texture);
            }
            java.lang.reflect.Method method = texture.getClass().getMethod("glId");
            return (int) method.invoke(texture);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * During HUD phase, redirect getMainRenderTarget() to a half-width
 * transparent FBO. This makes the GUI renderer draw HUD at half width
 * into our buffer, which we then composite onto both eyes.
 */
@Mixin(Minecraft.class)
public class MixinMinecraft {

    @Inject(
        method = "getMainRenderTarget",
        at = @At("HEAD"),
        cancellable = true
    )
    private void beeeye$overrideRenderTarget(
        CallbackInfoReturnable<RenderTarget> cir

        if (Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() && StereoRenderer.isHudPhase()) {
            RenderTarget hudFbo = StereoRenderer.getHudFbo();
            if (hudFbo != null) {
                cir.setReturnValue(hudFbo);
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * Redirect getMainRenderTarget() during stereo rendering:
 * - During eye rendering: redirect to current eye's half-width FBO
 * - During HUD phase: redirect to half-width hudFbo
 */
@Mixin(Minecraft.class)
public class MixinMinecraft {

    @Inject(method = "getMainRenderTarget", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$overrideRenderTarget(CallbackInfoReturnable<RenderTarget> cir) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled()) return;

        // During eye rendering, redirect to current eye's FBO
        if (StereoRenderer.isRenderingEye()) {
            RenderTarget eyeFbo = StereoRenderer.getCurrentEyeFbo();
            if (eyeFbo != null) {
                cir.setReturnValue(eyeFbo);
            }
            return;
        }

        // During HUD phase, redirect to hudFbo
        if (StereoRenderer.isHudPhase()) {
            RenderTarget hudFbo = StereoRenderer.getHudFbo();
            if (hudFbo != null) {
                cir.setReturnValue(hudFbo);
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye;

import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.TextureTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.CommandEncoder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

/**
 * Stereo 3D rendering with side-by-side output.
 *
 * 5-Phase Approach:
 * 1. Fake screen width to half for other mods (MixinWindow)
 * 2. During world render, use transparent HUD buffer - don't draw HUD yet
 * 3. Let Minecraft and mods draw their HUD to the transparent buffer
 * 4. Draw left eye world to left half, right eye world to right half
 * 5. Blend HUD buffer onto both eye halves
 */
public class StereoRenderer {

    public enum Eye {
        LEFT(-1),
        RIGHT(1);

        public final int sign;

        Eye(int sign) {
            this.sign = sign;
        }
    }

    // Current rendering state
    private static Eye currentEye = null;
    private static boolean inStereoPass = false;
    private static boolean renderingWorld = false;
    private static boolean renderingHud = false;
    private static boolean bypassMainTargetOverride = false;

    // Stereo rendering mode: false = off-axis projection (no chunk issues), true = camera offset (chunks freeze)
    private static boolean useCameraOffset = false;

    // HUD phase: true between stereo composite and end of render() — width faking active
    private static boolean hudPhase = false;

    // Eye rendering phase: true during each eye's renderLevel() — redirect target + fake width
    private static boolean renderingEye = false;

    // FBOs for eye rendering (full screen, we render to halves)
    private static RenderTarget leftEyeFbo = null;
    private static RenderTarget rightEyeFbo = null;

    // HUD FBO - half width, transparent background, captures all UI
    private static RenderTarget hudFbo = null;

    // Composite FBO - full width, used for alpha-blending HUD onto stereo image
    private static RenderTarget compositeTarget = null;

    // Cached dimensions
    private static int lastWidth = 0;
    private static int lastHeight = 0;

    // Faked width for UI rendering (half of real)
    private static int fakedWidth = 0;

    public static Eye getCurrentEye() {
        return currentEye;
    }

    public static boolean isInStereoPass() {
        return inStereoPass;
    }

    public static boolean isRenderingWorld() {
        return renderingWorld;
    }

    public static boolean isRenderingHud() {
        return renderingHud;
    }

    public static void setCurrentEye(Eye eye) {
        currentEye = eye;
    }

    public static void setInStereoPass(boolean inPass) {
        inStereoPass = inPass;
    }

    public static void setRenderingWorld(boolean rendering) {
        renderingWorld = rendering;
    }

    public static void setRenderingHud(boolean rendering) {
        renderingHud = rendering;
    }

    public static boolean shouldBypassMainTargetOverride() {
        return bypassMainTargetOverride;
    }

    public static void setBypassMainTargetOverride(boolean bypass) {
        bypassMainTargetOverride = bypass;
    }

    public static boolean useCameraOffset() {
        return useCameraOffset;
    }

    public static void setUseCameraOffset(boolean use) {
        useCameraOffset = use;
    }

    public static boolean isHudPhase() {
        return hudPhase;
    }

    public static void setHudPhase(boolean phase) {
        hudPhase = phase;
    }

    public static boolean isRenderingEye() {
        return renderingEye;
    }

    public static void setRenderingEye(boolean rendering) {
        renderingEye = rendering;
    }

    /**
     * Get the current eye's FBO (for render target redirect during eye rendering).
     */
    public static RenderTarget getCurrentEyeFbo() {
        if (currentEye == null) return null;
        return currentEye == Eye.LEFT ? leftEyeFbo : rightEyeFbo;
    }

    /**
     * Get the faked width for UI rendering (half of real width).
     */
    public static int getFakedWidth() {
        return fakedWidth;
    }

    /**
     * Get the full screen width.
     */
    public static int getFullWidth() {
        return lastWidth;
    }

    /**
     * Get the full screen height.
     */
    public static int getFullHeight() {
        return lastHeight;
    }

    /**
     * Check if width should be faked (during stereo mode, not rendering world).
     */
    public static boolean shouldFakeWidth() {
        return Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() && fakedWidth > 0 && !renderingWorld;
    }

    /**
     * Get camera X offset for current eye in blocks.
     */
    public static float getEyeOffset() {
        if (currentEye == null) return 0;
        float eyeDistance = BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue();
        return currentEye.sign * (eyeDistance / 2.0f);
    }

    /**
     * Get the projection matrix horizontal offset for off-axis stereo.
     * This creates asymmetric frustum - the camera stays in place but
     * the view is shifted left/right to create stereo parallax.
     *
     * The offset is applied to the projection matrix's [2][0] element,
     * which shifts the frustum horizontally without changing the camera position.
     *
     * @param aspectRatio The screen aspect ratio (width/height)
     * @param fovY The vertical field of view in radians
     * @return The projection matrix X offset to apply
     */
    public static float getProjectionOffset(float aspectRatio, float fovY) {
        if (currentEye == null || useCameraOffset) return 0;

        float eyeDistance = BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue();
        float halfEyeDistance = eyeDistance / 2.0f;

        // Convergence distance - where both eyes' views converge (no parallax)
        // Objects closer have crossed parallax, objects farther have uncrossed
        float convergenceDistance = 5.0f; // meters/blocks - tune this for comfort

        // Calculate the frustum shift based on eye separation and convergence
        // shift = (eyeOffset / convergenceDistance) * nearPlane
        // But we apply it directly to the projection matrix
        float shift = (halfEyeDistance / convergenceDistance);

        return currentEye.sign * shift;
    }

    public static int getScreenShift() {
        return BeeeyeConfig.SCREEN_SHIFT.get();
    }

    public static int getInterfaceShift() {
        return BeeeyeConfig.INTERFACE_SHIFT.get();
    }

    /**
     * Get crosshair offset for convergence at target distance.
     */
    public static int getCrosshairOffset() {
        if (currentEye == null) return 0;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return 0;

        double targetDistance = getTargetDistance();
        if (targetDistance <= 0) return 0;

        float eyeDistance = BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue();
        int guiWidth = mc.getWindow().getGuiScaledWidth();
        float screenFactor = guiWidth * 0.5f;
        float parallax = (float) (eyeDistance / targetDistance) * screenFactor;
        parallax = Math.min(parallax, guiWidth * 0.1f);

        return (int) (currentEye.sign * parallax);
    }

    public static double getTargetDistance() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return 100.0;

        HitResult hitResult = mc.hitResult;
        if (hitResult == null || hitResult.getType() == HitResult.Type.MISS) {
            return 100.0;
        }

        Vec3 hitLocation = hitResult.getLocation();
        Vec3 eyePosition = mc.player.getEyePosition();
        double distance = eyePosition.distanceTo(hitLocation);

        return Math.max(distance, 0.5);
    }

    /**
     * Initialize FBOs for stereo rendering.
     * Eye FBOs: half width each (for left/right eye world)
     * HUD FBO: half width (for UI overlay, transparent)
     */
    public static void ensureFramebuffers(int fullWidth, int fullHeight) {
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;

        if (
            leftEyeFbo != null &&
            lastWidth == fullWidth &&
            lastHeight == fullHeight
        ) {
            return;
        }

        Beeeye.LOGGER.info(
            "Creating stereo framebuffers: {}x{} (half: {})",
            fullWidth,
            fullHeight,
            halfWidth
        );

        cleanup();

        // Eye FBOs at half width - each eye gets its own half-screen FBO
        leftEyeFbo = new TextureTarget(
            "Beeeye Left Eye",
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            true
        );
        rightEyeFbo = new TextureTarget(
            "Beeeye Right Eye",
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            true
        );

        // HUD FBO at half width - transparent, for UI capture
        hudFbo = new TextureTarget("Beeeye HUD", halfWidth, fullHeight, true);

        // Composite FBO at full width - for alpha-blending HUD onto stereo
        compositeTarget = new TextureTarget(
            "Beeeye Composite",
            fullWidth,
            fullHeight,
            false
        );

        lastWidth = fullWidth;
        lastHeight = fullHeight;
        fakedWidth = halfWidth;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getLeftEyeFbo() {
        return leftEyeFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getRightEyeFbo() {
        return rightEyeFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getHudFbo() {
        return hudFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getEyeFbo(Eye eye) {
        return eye == Eye.LEFT ? leftEyeFbo : rightEyeFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getCompositeTarget() {
        return compositeTarget;
    }

    /**
     * Clear an FBO with transparent black.
     */
    public static void clearFbo(RenderTarget fbo) {
        if (fbo == null) return;
        GpuTexture colorTex = fbo.getColorTexture();
        GpuTexture depthTex = fbo.getDepthTexture();
        if (colorTex == null) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder =
            RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        if (depthTex != null) {
            encoder.clearColorAndDepthTextures(colorTex, 0, depthTex, 1.0);
        } else {
            encoder.clearColorTexture(colorTex, 0);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Copy texture region to screen.
     * copyTextureToTexture signature: (src, dst, mipLevel, dstX, dstY, srcX, srcY, width, height)
     */
    public static void copyToScreen(
        RenderTarget src,
        RenderTarget dst,
        int dstX,
        int dstY,
        int srcX,
        int srcY,
        int width,
        int height
    ) {
        if (src == null || dst == null) return;

        GpuTexture srcTex = src.getColorTexture();
        GpuTexture dstTex = dst.getColorTexture();
        if (srcTex == null || dstTex == null) return;

        // Clamp to valid bounds
        width = Math.min(
            width,
            Math.min(srcTex.getWidth(0) - srcX, dstTex.getWidth(0) - dstX)
        );
        height = Math.min(
            height,
            Math.min(srcTex.getHeight(0) - srcY, dstTex.getHeight(0) - dstY)
        );

        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder =
            RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
            srcTex,
            dstTex,
            0, // mipLevel
            dstX,
            dstY, // destination position
            srcX,
            srcY, // source position
            width,
            height
        );
    }

    /**
     * Composite stereo frame to main screen.
     * Left eye FBO -> left half of screen
     * Right eye FBO -> right half of screen
     */
    public static void compositeEyesToScreen(RenderTarget screen) {
        if (leftEyeFbo == null || rightEyeFbo == null || screen == null) return;

        int halfWidth = fakedWidth;
        int height = screen.height;
        int shift = getScreenShift();

        // Left eye to left half (position 0)
        int leftCopyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth, halfWidth + shift);
        copyToScreen(leftEyeFbo, screen, 0, 0, 0, 0, leftCopyWidth, height);

        // Right eye to right half (position halfWidth + shift)
        int rightDstX = halfWidth + shift;
        int rightCopyWidth = Math.min(halfWidth, screen.width - rightDstX);
        if (rightCopyWidth > 0) {
            copyToScreen(
                rightEyeFbo,
                screen,
                rightDstX,
                0,
                0,
                0,
                rightCopyWidth,
                height
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * Blend HUD onto both halves of the screen.
     * HUD FBO contains UI rendered at half width.
     */
    public static void blendHudToScreen(RenderTarget screen) {
        if (hudFbo == null || screen == null) return;

        int halfWidth = fakedWidth;
        int height = screen.height;
        int shift = getScreenShift();
        int interfaceShift = getInterfaceShift();

        // Copy HUD to left half
        copyToScreen(hudFbo, screen, 0, 0, 0, 0, halfWidth, height);

        // Copy HUD to right half (with shift)
        int rightDstX = halfWidth + shift;
        int rightCopyWidth = Math.min(
            halfWidth - shift,
            screen.width - rightDstX
        );
        if (rightCopyWidth > 0) {
            copyToScreen(
                hudFbo,
                screen,
                rightDstX,
                0,
                0,
                0,
                rightCopyWidth,
                height
            );
        }
    }

    public static void cleanup() {
        if (leftEyeFbo != null) {
            leftEyeFbo.destroyBuffers();
            leftEyeFbo = null;
        }
        if (rightEyeFbo != null) {
            rightEyeFbo.destroyBuffers();
            rightEyeFbo = null;
        }
        if (hudFbo != null) {
            hudFbo.destroyBuffers();
            hudFbo = null;
        }
        if (compositeTarget != null) {
            compositeTarget.destroyBuffers();
            compositeTarget = null;
        }
        lastWidth = 0;
        lastHeight = 0;
        fakedWidth = 0;
    }
}

package com.beeeye;

import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.CommandEncoder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ScreenEvent;

/**
 * Handles Screen (inventory, crafting, menus) rendering for stereo mode.
 *
 * With faked width, screens render at half width automatically.
 * After render, we copy from left half to right half.
 */
public class ScreenRenderHandler {

    /**
     * Get mouse X offset - no longer needed with faked width approach.
     * Mouse coordinates are already in half-width space.
     */
    public static double getMouseXOffset() {
        return 0;
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public void onScreenRenderPost(ScreenEvent.Render.Post event) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled()) {
            return;
        }

        Screen screen = event.getScreen();
        if (screen == null) {
            return;
        }

        // Copy left half to right half
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        RenderTarget mainTarget = mc.getMainRenderTarget();

        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        int height = mainTarget.height;
        int shift = StereoRenderer.getScreenShift();

        GpuTexture texture = mainTarget.getColorTexture();
        if (texture == null) return;

        CommandEncoder encoder =
            RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        // Copy left half to right half
        // copyTextureToTexture: (src, dst, mipLevel, dstX, dstY, srcX, srcY, width, height)
        encoder.copyTextureToTexture(
            texture,
            texture,
            0, // mipLevel
            halfWidth + shift,
            0, // dstX, dstY (right half)
            0,
            0, // srcX, srcY (left half)
            halfWidth - shift,
            height
        );
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.MouseHandler;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * Adjusts mouse X position for stereo mode.
 * With faked width, mouse X needs to be scaled to half-width space.
 */
@Mixin(MouseHandler.class)
public abstract class MixinMouseHandler {

    @Shadow
    private double xpos;

    /**
     * Scale mouse X to faked half-width space when screen is open.
     */
    @Inject(method = "xpos", at = @At("RETURN"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$scaleXpos(CallbackInfoReturnable<Double> cir) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || !StereoRenderer.shouldFakeWidth()) {
            return;
        }

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.screen == null) {
            return;
        }

        // Mouse is in full-width pixel space, UI expects half-width
        // Scale X coordinate to left half
        double fullWidth = mc.getMainRenderTarget().width;
        double halfWidth = StereoRenderer.getFakedWidth();

        double x = cir.getReturnValue();
        // Clamp to left half and scale
        if (x > halfWidth) {
            x = halfWidth;
        }
        cir.setReturnValue(x);
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.Camera;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

@Mixin(Camera.class)
public abstract class MixinCamera {

    @Shadow
    protected abstract void move(
        float distanceOffset,
        float verticalOffset,
        float horizontalOffset
    );

    /**
     * After camera setup, apply stereo eye offset.
     *
     * NEW APPROACH: We use off-axis projection instead of camera offset.
     * This avoids chunk cache issues because the camera position stays the same.
     * The stereo effect is achieved by shifting the projection matrix asymmetrically.
     *
     * Camera offset is still available via USE_CAMERA_OFFSET flag for entities
     * that don't use frustum culling (they work with camera offset).
     */
    @Inject(method = "setup", at = @At("TAIL"))
    private void applyEyeOffset(
        Level level,
        Entity entity,
        boolean detached,
        boolean thirdPersonReverse,
        float partialTick,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || !StereoRenderer.isInStereoPass()) {
            return;
        }

        // Use camera offset only if enabled (causes chunk issues but works for entities)
        // By default, we now use off-axis projection instead
        if (StereoRenderer.useCameraOffset()) {
            float offset = StereoRenderer.getEyeOffset();
            if (offset != 0) {
                // move(forward, up, right) - offset along right axis
                move(0, 0, offset);
            }
        }
    }
}

import net.neoforged.bus.api.IEventBus;
import net.neoforged.fml.ModContainer;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.Mod;
import net.neoforged.fml.config.ModConfig;
import net.neoforged.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLClientSetupEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ClientTickEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RegisterKeyMappingsEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.common.NeoForge;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

@Mod(Beeeye.MOD_ID)
public class Beeeye {

    public static final String MOD_ID = "beeeye";
    public static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MOD_ID);

    private static boolean stereoEnabled = false;

    public Beeeye(IEventBus modEventBus, ModContainer modContainer) {
        LOGGER.info("Beeeye initializing...");

        modContainer.registerConfig(ModConfig.Type.CLIENT, BeeeyeConfig.SPEC);

        modEventBus.addListener(this::onClientSetup);
        modEventBus.addListener(this::onRegisterKeyMappings);

        NeoForge.EVENT_BUS.addListener(this::onClientTick);
        NeoForge.EVENT_BUS.register(new ScreenRenderHandler());
        NeoForge.EVENT_BUS.register(new StereoRenderHandler());
    }

    private void onClientSetup(FMLClientSetupEvent event) {
        LOGGER.info("Beeeye client setup complete");
    }

    private void onRegisterKeyMappings(RegisterKeyMappingsEvent event) {
        event.register(BeeeyeKeyBindings.TOGGLE_STEREO);
        LOGGER.info("Beeeye keybindings registered");
    }

    private void onClientTick(ClientTickEvent.Post event) {
        while (BeeeyeKeyBindings.TOGGLE_STEREO.consumeClick()) {
            stereoEnabled = !stereoEnabled;
            LOGGER.info(
                "Stereo rendering: {}",
                stereoEnabled ? "ENABLED" : "DISABLED"
            );

            // Show on-screen message
            Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
            if (mc.player != null) {
                String status = stereoEnabled ? "ON" : "OFF";
                mc.player.displayClientMessage(
                    Component.literal("Beeeye Stereo: " + status),
                    true
                );
            }

            // Clean up FBOs when disabled
            if (!stereoEnabled) {
                StereoRenderer.cleanup();
            }
        }
    }

    public static boolean isStereoEnabled() {
        return stereoEnabled;
    }

    public static void setStereoEnabled(boolean enabled) {
        stereoEnabled = enabled;
        if (!enabled) {
            StereoRenderer.cleanup();
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye;

import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.TextureTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.CommandEncoder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;

/**
 * Stereo 3D renderer — state management and FBO lifecycle.
 *
 * Rendering phases (controlled by MixinGameRenderer):
 *   1. Eye rendering (renderingEye=true): each eye renders to its own
 *      half-width FBO via getMainRenderTarget() redirect + width faking.
 *      Off-axis projection (MixinProjectionMatrix) creates per-eye parallax.
 *   2. HUD phase (hudPhase=true): Minecraft + mods draw HUD into half-width
 *      hudFbo. Width faking + render target redirect active.
 *   3. Compositing (render TAIL): eye FBOs → main target halves,
 *      then alpha-blend hudFbo onto both halves via compositeTarget.
 */
public class StereoRenderer {

    public enum Eye {
        LEFT(-1), RIGHT(1);
        public final int sign;
        Eye(int sign) { this.sign = sign; }
    }

    // --- State flags ---
    private static Eye currentEye = null;
    private static boolean inStereoPass = false;
    private static boolean renderingEye = false;
    private static boolean hudPhase = false;
    private static boolean useCameraOffset = false;

    // --- FBOs ---
    private static RenderTarget leftEyeFbo = null;
    private static RenderTarget rightEyeFbo = null;
    private static RenderTarget hudFbo = null;
    private static RenderTarget compositeTarget = null;

    // --- Cached dimensions ---
    private static int lastWidth = 0;
    private static int lastHeight = 0;

    // =========================================================================
    // State accessors
    // =========================================================================

    public static Eye getCurrentEye()         { return currentEye; }
    public static void setCurrentEye(Eye eye) { currentEye = eye; }

    public static boolean isInStereoPass()            { return inStereoPass; }
    public static void setInStereoPass(boolean value) { inStereoPass = value; }

    public static boolean isRenderingEye()            { return renderingEye; }
    public static void setRenderingEye(boolean value) { renderingEye = value; }

    public static boolean isHudPhase()            { return hudPhase; }
    public static void setHudPhase(boolean value) { hudPhase = value; }

    public static boolean useCameraOffset()             { return useCameraOffset; }
    public static void setUseCameraOffset(boolean value) { useCameraOffset = value; }

    // =========================================================================
    // FBO accessors
    // =========================================================================

    public static RenderTarget getLeftEyeFbo()    { return leftEyeFbo; }
    public static RenderTarget getRightEyeFbo()   { return rightEyeFbo; }
    public static RenderTarget getHudFbo()        { return hudFbo; }
    public static RenderTarget getCompositeTarget() { return compositeTarget; }

    /** Current eye's FBO — used by MixinMinecraft to redirect getMainRenderTarget(). */
    public static RenderTarget getCurrentEyeFbo() {
        if (currentEye == null) return null;
        return currentEye == Eye.LEFT ? leftEyeFbo : rightEyeFbo;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // Off-axis projection
    // =========================================================================

    /**
     * Projection matrix m20 offset for asymmetric frustum stereo.
     * Camera stays in place; frustum shifts left/right per eye.
     * Objects at convergence distance (5 blocks) have zero parallax.
     */
    public static float getProjectionOffset(float aspectRatio, float fovY) {
        if (currentEye == null || useCameraOffset) return 0;
        float halfEyeDist = BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue() / 2.0f;
        float convergence = 5.0f;
        return currentEye.sign * (halfEyeDist / convergence);
    }

    /**
     * Camera X offset for camera-offset stereo (disabled by default).
     * Only used by MixinCamera when useCameraOffset=true.
     */
    public static float getEyeOffset() {
        if (currentEye == null) return 0;
        return currentEye.sign * (BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue() / 2.0f);
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // FBO lifecycle
    // =========================================================================

    /**
     * Create/recreate FBOs if dimensions changed.
     * Eye FBOs: half width, with depth. HUD FBO: half width, with depth.
     * Composite: full width, no depth (alpha blend intermediary).
     */
    public static void ensureFramebuffers(int fullWidth, int fullHeight) {
        if (leftEyeFbo != null && lastWidth == fullWidth && lastHeight == fullHeight) {
            return;
        }

        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Creating stereo FBOs: {}x{} (eye: {}x{})",
            fullWidth, fullHeight, halfWidth, fullHeight);

        cleanup();

        leftEyeFbo     = new TextureTarget("Beeeye Left Eye",  halfWidth, fullHeight, true);
        rightEyeFbo    = new TextureTarget("Beeeye Right Eye", halfWidth, fullHeight, true);
        hudFbo         = new TextureTarget("Beeeye HUD",       halfWidth, fullHeight, true);
        compositeTarget = new TextureTarget("Beeeye Composite", fullWidth, fullHeight, false);

        lastWidth = fullWidth;
        lastHeight = fullHeight;
    }

    /** Clear FBO to transparent black (color + depth if present). */
    public static void clearFbo(RenderTarget fbo) {
        if (fbo == null) return;
        GpuTexture color = fbo.getColorTexture();
        if (color == null) return;
        CommandEncoder enc = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        GpuTexture depth = fbo.getDepthTexture();
        if (depth != null) {
            enc.clearColorAndDepthTextures(color, 0, depth, 1.0);
        } else {
            enc.clearColorTexture(color, 0);
        }
    }

    public static void cleanup() {
        if (leftEyeFbo != null)     { leftEyeFbo.destroyBuffers();     leftEyeFbo = null; }
        if (rightEyeFbo != null)    { rightEyeFbo.destroyBuffers();    rightEyeFbo = null; }
        if (hudFbo != null)         { hudFbo.destroyBuffers();         hudFbo = null; }
        if (compositeTarget != null) { compositeTarget.destroyBuffers(); compositeTarget = null; }
        lastWidth = 0;
        lastHeight = 0;
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.MouseHandler;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * Clamp mouse X to left half when a Screen (inventory, etc.) is open in stereo.
 * Screens render at half width, so mouse must stay within that range.
 */
@Mixin(MouseHandler.class)
public abstract class MixinMouseHandler {

    @Inject(method = "xpos", at = @At("RETURN"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$clampXpos(CallbackInfoReturnable<Double> cir) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled()) return;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.screen == null) return;

        double halfWidth = mc.getWindow().getWidth(); // already faked to half during hudPhase
        double x = cir.getReturnValue();
        if (x > halfWidth) {
            cir.setReturnValue(halfWidth);
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.Camera;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * Camera-offset stereo (disabled by default — causes chunk freeze).
 * Enabled via StereoRenderer.setUseCameraOffset(true) for testing.
 * Normal mode uses off-axis projection instead (MixinProjectionMatrix).
 */
@Mixin(Camera.class)
public abstract class MixinCamera {

    @Shadow
    protected abstract void move(float distanceOffset, float verticalOffset, float horizontalOffset);

    @Inject(method = "setup", at = @At("TAIL"))
    private void beeeye$applyEyeOffset(Level level, Entity entity, boolean detached,
            boolean thirdPersonReverse, float partialTick, CallbackInfo ci) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || !StereoRenderer.isInStereoPass()) return;
        if (!StereoRenderer.useCameraOffset()) return;

        float offset = StereoRenderer.getEyeOffset();
        if (offset != 0) {
            move(0, 0, offset); // (forward, up, right)
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.joml.Matrix4f;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * Off-axis stereo: shift projection matrix m20 to create asymmetric frustum.
 * Camera stays in place (no chunk cache issues). Each eye gets a different
 * frustum shift, producing stereo parallax.
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinProjectionMatrix {

    @Shadow @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Inject(method = "getProjectionMatrix", at = @At("RETURN"))
    private void beeeye$applyOffAxisShift(float fov, CallbackInfoReturnable<Matrix4f> cir) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || !StereoRenderer.isInStereoPass()) return;
        if (StereoRenderer.useCameraOffset()) return;

        Matrix4f matrix = cir.getReturnValue();
        if (matrix == null) return;

        float aspect = (float) minecraft.getWindow().getWidth()
                     / (float) minecraft.getWindow().getHeight();
        float shift = StereoRenderer.getProjectionOffset(aspect, (float) Math.toRadians(fov));

        if (shift != 0) {
            matrix.m20(matrix.m20() + shift);
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.platform.Window;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * Fake window width to half during stereo rendering.
 * Active during eye rendering (correct aspect ratio for half-width FBO)
 * and HUD phase (positions UI elements within half-width buffer).
 */
@Mixin(Window.class)
public class MixinWindow {

    @Shadow private int framebufferWidth;
    @Shadow private int guiScaledWidth;
    @Shadow private int width;

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$shouldFake() {
        return Beeeye.isStereoEnabled()
            && (StereoRenderer.isRenderingEye() || StereoRenderer.isHudPhase());
    }

    @Inject(method = "getWidth", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$fakeWidth(CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if (beeeye$shouldFake()) cir.setReturnValue(framebufferWidth / 2);
    }

    @Inject(method = "getScreenWidth", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$fakeScreenWidth(CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if (beeeye$shouldFake()) cir.setReturnValue(width / 2);
    }

    @Inject(method = "getGuiScaledWidth", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$fakeGuiScaledWidth(CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if (beeeye$shouldFake()) cir.setReturnValue(guiScaledWidth / 2);
    }
}

package com.beeeye;

import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.TextureTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.CommandEncoder;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;

/**
 * Stereo 3D renderer — state management and FBO lifecycle.
 *
 * Rendering phases (controlled by MixinGameRenderer):
 *   1. Eye rendering (renderingEye=true): each eye renders to its own
 *      half-width FBO via getMainRenderTarget() redirect + width faking.
 *      Off-axis projection (MixinProjectionMatrix) creates per-eye parallax.
 *   2. HUD phase (hudPhase=true): Minecraft + mods draw HUD into half-width
 *      hudFbo. Width faking + render target redirect active.
 *   3. Compositing (render TAIL): eye FBOs → main target halves,
 *      then alpha-blend hudFbo onto both halves via compositeTarget.
 */
public class StereoRenderer {

    public enum Eye {
        LEFT(-1),
        RIGHT(1);

        public final int sign;

        Eye(int sign) {
            this.sign = sign;
        }
    }

    // --- State flags ---
    private static Eye currentEye = null;
    private static boolean inStereoPass = false;
    private static boolean renderingEye = false;
    private static boolean hudPhase = false;
    private static boolean useCameraOffset = false;

    // --- FBOs ---
    private static RenderTarget leftEyeFbo = null;
    private static RenderTarget rightEyeFbo = null;
    private static RenderTarget hudFbo = null;
    private static RenderTarget compositeTarget = null;

    // --- Cached dimensions ---
    private static int lastWidth = 0;
    private static int lastHeight = 0;

    // =========================================================================
    // State accessors
    // =========================================================================

    public static Eye getCurrentEye() {
        return currentEye;
    }

    public static void setCurrentEye(Eye eye) {
        currentEye = eye;
    }

    public static boolean isInStereoPass() {
        return inStereoPass;
    }

    public static void setInStereoPass(boolean value) {
        inStereoPass = value;
    }

    public static boolean isRenderingEye() {
        return renderingEye;
    }

    public static void setRenderingEye(boolean value) {
        renderingEye = value;
    }

    public static boolean isHudPhase() {
        return hudPhase;
    }

    public static void setHudPhase(boolean value) {
        hudPhase = value;
    }

    public static boolean useCameraOffset() {
        return useCameraOffset;
    }

    public static void setUseCameraOffset(boolean value) {
        useCameraOffset = value;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // FBO accessors
    // =========================================================================

    public static RenderTarget getLeftEyeFbo() {
        return leftEyeFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getRightEyeFbo() {
        return rightEyeFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getHudFbo() {
        return hudFbo;
    }

    public static RenderTarget getCompositeTarget() {
        return compositeTarget;
    }

    /** Current eye's FBO — used by MixinMinecraft to redirect getMainRenderTarget(). */
    public static RenderTarget getCurrentEyeFbo() {
        if (currentEye == null) return null;
        return currentEye == Eye.LEFT ? leftEyeFbo : rightEyeFbo;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // Off-axis projection
    // =========================================================================

    /**
     * Projection matrix m20 offset for asymmetric frustum stereo.
     * Camera stays in place; frustum shifts left/right per eye.
     * Objects at convergence distance (5 blocks) have zero parallax.
     */
    public static float getProjectionOffset(float aspectRatio, float fovY) {
        if (currentEye == null || useCameraOffset) return 0;
        float halfEyeDist = BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue() / 2.0f;
        float convergence = 5.0f;
        return currentEye.sign * (halfEyeDist / convergence);
    }

    /**
     * Camera X offset for camera-offset stereo (disabled by default).
     * Only used by MixinCamera when useCameraOffset=true.
     */
    public static float getEyeOffset() {
        if (currentEye == null) return 0;
        return (
            currentEye.sign *
            (BeeeyeConfig.EYE_DISTANCE.get().floatValue() / 2.0f)
        );
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // FBO lifecycle
    // =========================================================================

    /**
     * Create/recreate FBOs if dimensions changed.
     * Eye FBOs: half width, with depth. HUD FBO: half width, with depth.
     * Composite: full width, no depth (alpha blend intermediary).
     */
    public static void ensureFramebuffers(int fullWidth, int fullHeight) {
        if (
            leftEyeFbo != null &&
            lastWidth == fullWidth &&
            lastHeight == fullHeight
        ) {
            return;
        }

        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;
        Beeeye.LOGGER.info(
            "Creating stereo FBOs: {}x{} (eye: {}x{})",
            fullWidth,
            fullHeight,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight
        );

        cleanup();

        leftEyeFbo = new TextureTarget(
            "Beeeye Left Eye",
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            true
        );
        rightEyeFbo = new TextureTarget(
            "Beeeye Right Eye",
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            true
        );
        hudFbo = new TextureTarget("Beeeye HUD", halfWidth, fullHeight, true);
        compositeTarget = new TextureTarget(
            "Beeeye Composite",
            fullWidth,
            fullHeight,
            false
        );

        lastWidth = fullWidth;
        lastHeight = fullHeight;
    }

    /** Clear FBO to transparent black (color + depth if present). */
    public static void clearFbo(RenderTarget fbo) {
        if (fbo == null) return;
        GpuTexture color = fbo.getColorTexture();
        if (color == null) return;
        CommandEncoder enc = RenderSystem.getDevice().createCommandEncoder();
        GpuTexture depth = fbo.getDepthTexture();
        if (depth != null) {
            enc.clearColorAndDepthTextures(color, 0, depth, 1.0);
        } else {
            enc.clearColorTexture(color, 0);
        }
    }

    public static void cleanup() {
        if (leftEyeFbo != null) {
            leftEyeFbo.destroyBuffers();
            leftEyeFbo = null;
        }
        if (rightEyeFbo != null) {
            rightEyeFbo.destroyBuffers();
            rightEyeFbo = null;
        }
        if (hudFbo != null) {
            hudFbo.destroyBuffers();
            hudFbo = null;
        }
        if (compositeTarget != null) {
            compositeTarget.destroyBuffers();
            compositeTarget = null;
        }
        lastWidth = 0;
        lastHeight = 0;
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer.Eye;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.textures.GpuTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11;
import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL30;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Final;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Unique;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

/**
 * Stereo rendering: each eye renders to its own half-width FBO,
 * then composited to main target. HUD alpha-composited onto both eyes.
 *
 * Key insight: redirect getMainRenderTarget() to eye FBO during renderLevel(),
 * so Minecraft renders directly into half-width buffer with correct aspect ratio.
 * Off-axis projection (MixinProjectionMatrix) provides per-eye parallax.
 */
@Mixin(GameRenderer.class)
public abstract class MixinGameRenderer {

    @Shadow
    @Final
    private Minecraft minecraft;

    @Shadow
    public abstract void renderLevel(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Shadow
    public abstract void updateCamera(DeltaTracker deltaTracker);

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$inStereoRender = false;

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$frameCount = 0;

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$stereoReady = false;

    /**
     * Intercept renderLevel() — render both eyes into separate half-width FBOs.
     */
    @Inject(method = "renderLevel", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$onRenderLevel(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() || beeeye$inStereoRender) return;
        if (minecraft.level == null) return;

        ci.cancel();
        beeeye$inStereoRender = true;
        try {
            beeeye$renderStereoFrame(deltaTracker);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.error("Stereo render error", e);
        } finally {
            beeeye$inStereoRender = false;
            StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);
            StereoRenderer.setRenderingEye(false);
            StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        }
    }

    /**
     * After render() completes, HUD is in hudFbo. Restore stereo world,
     * alpha-composite HUD onto both halves.
     */
    @Inject(method = "render", at = @At("TAIL"))
    private void beeeye$onRenderTail(
        DeltaTracker deltaTracker,
        boolean doRenderLevel,
        CallbackInfo ci
    ) {
        if (!beeeye$stereoReady) return;
        beeeye$stereoReady = false;
        StereoRenderer.setHudPhase(false);

        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        RenderTarget leftFbo = StereoRenderer.getLeftEyeFbo();
        RenderTarget rightFbo = StereoRenderer.getRightEyeFbo();
        RenderTarget hudFbo = StereoRenderer.getHudFbo();
        RenderTarget compositeRT = StereoRenderer.getCompositeTarget();
        if (
            leftFbo == null ||
            rightFbo == null ||
            hudFbo == null ||
            compositeRT == null
        ) return;

        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;
        int halfWidth = fullWidth / 2;

        int mainTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(mainTarget.getColorTexture());
        int leftTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(leftFbo.getColorTexture());
        int rightTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(rightFbo.getColorTexture());
        int hudTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(hudFbo.getColorTexture());
        int compositeTexId = beeeye$getTextureId(compositeRT.getColorTexture());
        if (
            mainTexId <= 0 ||
            leftTexId <= 0 ||
            rightTexId <= 0 ||
            hudTexId <= 0 ||
            compositeTexId <= 0
        ) return;

        // Temp GL FBOs wrapping RenderTarget textures
        int mainGlFbo = beeeye$wrapTexAsFbo(mainTexId);
        int leftGlFbo = beeeye$wrapTexAsFbo(leftTexId);
        int rightGlFbo = beeeye$wrapTexAsFbo(rightTexId);
        int hudGlFbo = beeeye$wrapTexAsFbo(hudTexId);
        int compositeGlFbo = beeeye$wrapTexAsFbo(compositeTexId);

        // Restore stereo world: eye FBOs → main target halves
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, leftGlFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, mainGlFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, rightGlFbo);
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            halfWidth,
            0,
            fullWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // Alpha-composite HUD onto both eyes in single pass
        StereoRenderer.clearFbo(compositeRT);

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, hudGlFbo);
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, compositeGlFbo);

        // HUD into left half
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        // HUD into right half
        GL30.glBlitFramebuffer(
            0,
            0,
            halfWidth,
            fullHeight,
            halfWidth,
            0,
            fullWidth,
            fullHeight,
            GL11.GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL11.GL_NEAREST
        );

        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);
        compositeRT.blitAndBlendToTexture(mainTarget.getColorTextureView());

        // Cleanup
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(mainGlFbo);
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(leftGlFbo);
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(rightGlFbo);
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(hudGlFbo);
        GL30.glDeleteFramebuffers(compositeGlFbo);
    }

    @Unique
    private void beeeye$renderStereoFrame(DeltaTracker deltaTracker) {
        beeeye$frameCount++;
        boolean debug = (beeeye$frameCount % 300 == 1);

        RenderTarget mainTarget = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
        int fullWidth = mainTarget.width;
        int fullHeight = mainTarget.height;

        StereoRenderer.ensureFramebuffers(fullWidth, fullHeight);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(true);

        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info(
                "Stereo frame #{}: {}x{}",
                beeeye$frameCount,
                fullWidth,
                fullHeight
            );
        }

        // === LEFT EYE ===
        // Redirect getMainRenderTarget() to left eye FBO, fake width to half
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.LEFT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingEye(true);
        StereoRenderer.clearFbo(StereoRenderer.getLeftEyeFbo());
        updateCamera(deltaTracker);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingEye(false);

        // === RIGHT EYE ===
        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(Eye.RIGHT);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingEye(true);
        StereoRenderer.clearFbo(StereoRenderer.getRightEyeFbo());
        updateCamera(deltaTracker);
        renderLevel(deltaTracker);
        StereoRenderer.setRenderingEye(false);

        StereoRenderer.setCurrentEye(null);
        StereoRenderer.setInStereoPass(false);

        // Clear hudFbo, enable HUD phase
        StereoRenderer.clearFbo(StereoRenderer.getHudFbo());
        beeeye$stereoReady = true;
        StereoRenderer.setHudPhase(true);

        if (debug) {
            Beeeye.LOGGER.info("Stereo eyes saved, HUD phase active");
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$wrapTexAsFbo(int textureId) {
        int fbo = GL30.glGenFramebuffers();
        GL30.glBindFramebuffer(GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);
        GL30.glFramebufferTexture2D(
            GL30.GL_FRAMEBUFFER,
            GL30.GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
            GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D,
            textureId,
            0
        );
        return fbo;
    }

    @Unique
    private int beeeye$getTextureId(GpuTexture texture) {
        if (texture == null) return -1;
        try {
            if (texture.getClass().getName().contains("Validation")) {
                java.lang.reflect.Method unwrap = texture
                    .getClass()
                    .getMethod("getRealTexture");
                texture = (GpuTexture) unwrap.invoke(texture);
            }
            java.lang.reflect.Method method = texture
                .getClass()
                .getMethod("glId");
            return (int) method.invoke(texture);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderTarget;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * Redirect getMainRenderTarget() during stereo rendering:
 * - During eye rendering: redirect to current eye's half-width FBO
 * - During HUD phase: redirect to half-width hudFbo
 */
@Mixin(Minecraft.class)
public class MixinMinecraft {

    @Inject(
        method = "getMainRenderTarget",
        at = @At("HEAD"),
        cancellable = true
    )
    private void beeeye$overrideRenderTarget(
        CallbackInfoReturnable<RenderTarget> cir
    ) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled()) return;

        // During eye rendering, redirect to current eye's FBO
        if (StereoRenderer.isRenderingEye()) {
            RenderTarget eyeFbo = StereoRenderer.getCurrentEyeFbo();
            if (eyeFbo != null) {
                cir.setReturnValue(eyeFbo);
            }
            return;
        }

        // During HUD phase, redirect to hudFbo
        if (StereoRenderer.isHudPhase()) {
            RenderTarget hudFbo = StereoRenderer.getHudFbo();
            if (hudFbo != null) {
                cir.setReturnValue(hudFbo);
            }
        }
    }
}

import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * Fake window width to half during stereo rendering.
 * Active during eye rendering (correct aspect ratio for half-width FBO)
 * and HUD phase (positions UI elements within half-width buffer).
 */
@Mixin(Window.class)
public class MixinWindow {

    @Shadow
    private int framebufferWidth;

    @Shadow
    private int guiScaledWidth;

    @Shadow
    private int width;

    @Unique
    private boolean beeeye$shouldFake() {
        return (
            Beeeye.isStereoEnabled() &&
            (StereoRenderer.isRenderingEye() || StereoRenderer.isHudPhase())
        );
    }

    @Inject(method = "getWidth", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$fakeWidth(CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if (beeeye$shouldFake()) cir.setReturnValue(framebufferWidth / 2);
    }

    @Inject(method = "getScreenWidth", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$fakeScreenWidth(CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if (beeeye$shouldFake()) cir.setReturnValue(width / 2);
    }

    @Inject(method = "getGuiScaledWidth", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$fakeGuiScaledWidth(
        CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir
    ) {
        if (beeeye$shouldFake()) cir.setReturnValue(guiScaledWidth / 2);
    }
}

package com.beeeye.mixin;

import com.beeeye.Beeeye;
import com.beeeye.StereoRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.MouseHandler;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

/**
 * Clamp mouse X to left half when a Screen (inventory, etc.) is open in stereo.
 * Screens render at half width, so mouse must stay within that range.
 */
@Mixin(MouseHandler.class)
public abstract class MixinMouseHandler {

    @Inject(method = "xpos", at = @At("RETURN"), cancellable = true)
    private void beeeye$clampXpos(CallbackInfoReturnable<Double> cir) {
        if (!Beeeye.isStereoEnabled()) return;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.screen == null) return;

        double halfWidth = mc.getWindow().getWidth(); // already faked to half during hudPhase
        double x = cir.getReturnValue();
        if (x > halfWidth) {
            cir.setReturnValue(halfWidth);
        }
    }
}
